en:
What then is the meaning of the pillar of fire? We
need the fire in the night, when it is dark. But the meaning is
the same as that of the cloud. The cloud is the fire, and the
fire is the cloud. When the sun shines, the Lord’s presence
takes the appearance of a cloud; when darkness comes,
it takes the appearance of fire. It is the same entity with
different appearances. Then what does the fire represent?
It represents the Word. The cloud is the Spirit, and the fire is
the Word. When the sun is shining, you are very clear in the
Spirit; you can easily follow the cloud. But many times it
is just like night and you are in darkness. You cannot trust
your spirit; your spirit is very much perplexed. In such a
situation, you must trust the Word. The Word is like the
fire, burning, shining, and enlightening. Psalm 119:105
says, “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my
path.” When the sky is so clear and everything is so bright,
the cloud is adequate. But when darkness veils the sky,

en: Thematterweneedtoattendtoisthis:onlythatwhichis out of Christ can be of any value and spiritual use in the church. God never uses the old creation to construct the new creation. Neither does God use that which is of man to con- struct that which is of God. He can never, never use fleshly things to produce something spiritual. The Lord Jesus said, “That which is born of the Spirit is spirit”(John 3:6b).Would it be possible for that which is born of the flesh to become spirit? No! “That which is born of the flesh is flesh.”
mz: Kan ngaihsak ṭul thil pakhat chu hei hi a ni: Krista aṭanga chhuak chauhin kohhranah hlutna leh thlarau lamah ṭangkâina an nei. Pathianin thil siam hlui chu thil siam thar sakchhoh nân a hmang ngai lo. Pathianin mihring thil chu Pathian thil sakchhoh nan a hmang ngai hek lo. Thlarau lam thil siam chhuah nân tisa thilte a hmang thei lo. Isua chuan heti hian a sawi a, “Thlarau a piang te apiang thlarau a ni” (Joh. 3:6). Tisaa piang ni si Thlaraua lo chan chu a theih angem? mz: ‘He mi hi kan thah a ni lo va, a thattu pawh kan hre lo.

en: (John 13:34) As he lingers in that room, Jesus lovingly prepares them for his imminent departure .
mz: (Johana 13:34) Chu pindana an awm khaw tlai lai chuan, a kalsan thuai dâwn avângin hmangaih takin a puahchah mial mial bawk a ni.

en: (Matthew 7:12) Note what he also said about displaying brotherly love: “By this all will know that you are my disciples, if you have love among yourselves .”
mz: (Matthaia 7:12) Unau hmangaihna lantîr chungchânga a thusawi pawh hi lo chhinchhiah teh: “In inhmangaih chuan mi zawng zawngin ka zirtîrte in ni tih chu miah chuan an hria ang,” a ti a ni.

en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye saw it, did not even repent yourselves afterward, that ye might believe him.
mz: Johana chuan kawng dik a rawn kawhhmuh che u a, amah chu in ring si lo va; chhiahkhawntute leh nawhchizuarte erawh chuan amah chu an ring a, nangnin chu chu in hmuh hnu pawhin amah chu ring tûrin in lamlêt si lo va.

en: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
mz: “Leiah han tlûk teh,” a ti a. Leiah a han tlûk a, rûlah a chang ta mai a; hlauvin Mosia chu a tlânchhia a.

en: [[ A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed]. I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
mz:
Eng lai pawhin Lalpa chu ka fak ang a,
Tâwp lo tawpin ka fak zêl ang.

en: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto Jehovah; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
mz: A pathumna chu Zikria fapa Amasia a ni, sipai nuaihnih a ho va (Amasa hi hetianga Lalpa rawngbâwl tûra inpe a ni).

en: and said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as beforetime; but the God of my father hath been with me.
mz: an hnênah, “In pa mi en dân hi tûn hma a ang ta lo tih ka hmu thei a ni; mahse, ka pa Pathian chuan min awmpui zêl a.

en: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
mz: Tin, Davida chuan, “Philistia mite bei tûrin ka han chho dâwn êm? Ka kuta hian anniho chu i pe dâwn em?” tiin LALPA a rawn a. Tin, LALPA chuan, “Han chho rawh; anniho chu i kutah ka pe dâwn a ni,” a ti a.

en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; And, Issachar, in thy tents.
mz:
Zebulun leh Isakar chungchâng hetiangin a sawi:
“Tuifinriata sumdâwng, Zebulun chu hmuingîl rawh se,
Isakar pawh in lamah a chan ṭha rawh se.

en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.
mz: a ram ropui tak rote leh a lal ropui nasatzia, rei tak ni za leh ni sawmriat zet a entir a.

en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
mz: Heng hi LALPAN Mosia hmanga Jeriko zawn Jordan rala Moab phaia Israela thlahte a pêk, thupêkte leh rorel dante chu a ni.

en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
mz: Hezekia chuan a dam chhûngin râlmuang leh him takin an awm dâwn tihna niin a ngai a, Isaia hnênah, “Lalpa thu i sawi chu a ṭha e,” a ti a.

en: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the mufflers;
mz: bengbeh te, ngûn te, hmai khuhna te,

en: and the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
mz:
Isaka hmunsângte chu tihram a ni ang a,
Israel Hmun Thianghlimte chu tihchhiat a ni ang.
Jeroboama chhûngte lalna chu ka titâwp ang,” a ti a.

en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee; I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
mz: Josua, i dam chhûngin, tu man an chelh lo vang che. Mosia hnêna ka awm ang khân i hnênah pawh ka awm reng ang a, ka awmpui reng ang chia, ka thlahthlam tawp lo vang che.

en: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
mz: LALPA ânchhia chu mi suaksual inah a awm a, Mi felte chenna erawh chu mal a sawm thin.

en: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
mz: Israela thlahte sualna, i chunga kan sualna thupha ka chawi chhûng hian i beng lo chhiin i mit lo meng la, i chhiahhlawh ?awng?aina, i hnêna a chhûn a zâna i chhiahhlawh Israela thlahte ka ngensakna hi lo ngaithla teh ang che; kei leh ka pa chhûngte chu kan lo sual ta si a.

en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
mz: Khawihli avângin dawithiamho chuan Mosia chu an chelh ta lo va; khawihli chu Aigupta mi zawng zawng leh dawithiamte chuan an vei vek a ni.

en: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
mz:
Pathian zârah huai takin kan che ang,
Kan hmêlmate a chîl hrep ang.

en: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.
mz: Thu dik ka hrilh a che u, rorêl ni-ah chuan chu khaw tuar tûr ai chuan Sodom leh Gomora ram tuar tûr chu a ziaawm zâwk ang.

en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
mz: A ni, rukru angin mi an chang a, Mihring zingah vervekna an tipung thin.

en: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, that his soul was vexed unto death.
mz: Ni tin a nawr a, a zawh tlut tlut avâng chuan a ning tawngkhawng chuan a hrilh ta mai a.

en: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
mz: Tin, Lalpa thu chu Zakaria hnênah a lo thleng a,

en: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute for ever throughout your generations.
mz: Arona leh a thlahte hi tawtawrâwt hâmtu tûrte chu an ni. Hetiang hi kumkhaw tih dân tûr a ni.

en: Thus shalt thou say unto him, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.
mz: Lalpa chuan, ‘Ngai teh, ram pumah ka lo sak tawh chu ka ṭhiat ang a, ka lo phun tawh pawh ka pawt leh ang.

en: All this have I proved in wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
mz: Finna hmangin hêng hi ka finfiah a, ‘Ka la fing ve ang,’ ka ti a; mahse, a teuh lo mai.

en: or have found that which was lost, and deal falsely therein, and swear to a lie; in any of all these things that a man doeth, sinning therein;
mz: tin, thil bo a chhar si chhar lo angin chhia a chham chuan,

en:
The other two places which speak of the inward knowledge
are John 17:3 and Ephesians 1:17. John 17:3 says that those
who have the eternal life of God are those who know God.
This means that God’s life within can cause us to know Him.
Ephesians 1:17 says that God gives us the spirit of wisdom
and revelation so that we may know Him. The spirit men-
tioned here is our human spirit related to the Spirit of God.
This means that our spirit with the spirit of God can cause us
to know God from within.
mz:
Chhûnglam hriatna chungchâng sawi lehna hmun dang pahnihte
chu Johana 17:3 leh Ephesi 1:17 te an ni a. Pathian chatuan nunna
neitute chu Pathian hretute an ni, tiin Johana 17:3 chuan a sawi a.
Hemi awmzia chu kan chhûnga Pathian nunna hian Amah hre turin
min siam thei a ni tihna a ni. Pathian chuan Amah hriatna kawngah
finna thlarau leh thupuan min pe a, tichuan Amah kan hre dawn a ni tiin
Ephesi 1:17 chuan a sawi a. Heta thlarau tarlan hi kan mihring thlarau
Pathian Thlarau nena inzawm chu a ni a. Hemi awmzia chu Pathian
Thlarau nena kan thlarau chuan chhûnglam aṭanga Pathian hre turin
min siam thei a ni.

en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
mz: Zilhna mi tizaktu chu ka hre ta a, Ka hriatthiamna rilru chuan mi chhâng a ni.

en: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? And scoffers delight them in scoffing, And fools hate knowledge?
mz:
‘Mi mâwlte u, mâwl reng in duh em ni,
Eng chen nge finna hi in hmuhsit anga,
Mi â pawhin hriatna hi a hmuhsit ang?

en: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god that is able to deliver after this sort.
mz: Chuvângin, hetiang hian thu ka pe e: Sadraka te, Mesaka te, Abednegoa te Pathian sawichhetu hnam emaw, chi emaw, ṭawng chi hrang hmang emaw rêng rêng chu an kut leh an ke pawhsawmsak an ni ang a, an inte pawh tihram a ni bawk ang. Hetianga mi chhan chhuak thei Pathian dang tu mah an awm lo,” a ti a.

en: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away when he trespassed, have we prepared and sanctified; and, behold, they are before the altar of Jehovah.
mz: Ahazan Lalpa laka suahsual a bâwl laia Tempul bungbêl a lâk chhuahte kha kan dah kîr a, kan tithianghlim vek tawh a, Lalpa maichâm bulah engkim dah fel a ni tawh,” an rawn ti a.

en: And from the bottom upon the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the breadth a cubit.
mz: Tawng khat chhawrin tawng hniha sâng lung rem chhoh tûr a ni a, heta ṭang hian tawng khat chhawra tawng li-a sâng lung rem chhoh leh tûr a ni a.

en: “Go on bringing them up in the discipline and mental- regulating of Jehovah.” —EPHESIANS 6:4.
mz: “Lalpa thununnaah leh zilhnaah chuan enkawl zâwk rawh u.” —EPHESI 6:4.

en: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
mz: Thla nei kea kal chi zawng zawng te chu in tan thil bawlhhlawh a ni a,

en: If they sin against thee (for there is no man that sinneth not), and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive unto the land of the enemy, far off or near;
mz: “I miten i laka thil an tihsuala, (tu mah thil tisual lo an awm si lo) i thinura an hmêlmate i hnehtîra, sala an hruaiin an hruaina ram chu hla hle mah se,

en: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
mz: tin, i chunga rorêltute chu a tira an awm ang khan ka awmtir leh ang a, i chhûnga remruattute chu a hmasa bera an awm ang khan ka awmtir leh bawk ang: chu mi hnuah chuan, ‘Felna khawpui, khawpui rinawm tak,’ an la ti ang che.

en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.
mz: “Eden huanah, nang anga lian leh ropui a awm em ni? Eden huana thingte ang bawkin mitthi khuaah i chhuk ang a, khandaiha sah hlum, serh tan lohho zîngah chuan i awm ve ang. Chûng chu Farawa leh a hote an ni,” Lalpa Pathian thuchhuak chuan a ti.

en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
mz: Leia mi suaksualte zawng zawng chu englo êkchhia angin i tibo thin a: Chuvangin i thuhriattirte chu ka ngaina a ni.

en: And he carved [thereon] cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.
mz: Chûngah chuan cherub thla nei lem te, tûm thing lem te, pangpâr lem te a ker a, rangkachakin a luan leh vek a.

en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
mz: Ram sabengtung no mihringa a pian hunah Mi lawilo chuan hriatna a nei chauh vang.

en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
mz: Tichan zâwlnei Isaia chuan LALPA a han au va; tin, Ahaza darchinhriatnaa hlim hniam tawh chu rahka sawm thlengin a tikir leh ta a.

en: And they shall eat, and not have enough; they shall play the harlot, and shall not increase; because they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.
mz:
Inthawina sa an ei ṭeuh ṭeuh va,
An kham si lo,
Chi ṭhatna pathian an pan a, fa an ngah chuang lo,
Lalpa chu an hawisan avângin.

en: And the near kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: take thou my right of redemption on thee; for I cannot redeem it.
mz: An laichînpa chuan, “Ka tân chuan ka tlan thei lo, chutilo zawng, ka roluah chungchângah harsatna ka siam dah ang e, tlantu tûr ka nihna pawh nangman chang mai la, ka tlan thei lo a ni e,” a ti a.

en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
mz: Tin, puithiamin sual thawina thisen chu a kut zungtangin tlem a pir ang a, halral thilhlan maichâm kiahte chuan a tat ang a, halral thilhlan maichâm bulah a thisen chu a chhûng chhuak tur a ni.

en: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
mz: Hmasang nite chu hre reng la, Chhuan tam tak kumte chu ngaihtuah teh: I pa zawt la, a kawhhmuh ang che; I upate pawh, an hrilh ang che.

en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
mz: Israela thlahte zawng zawng chuan chutiang chuan an ti a, LALPAN Mosia leh Arona thu a pêk ang ngei chuan an ti ta a.

en: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
mz: An thlahtute Aigupta ram aṭanga an lo chhuah aṭang tawh khân tûn thlengin, ‘hei chu thil sual a ni’ ka tih chu an ti ṭhîn a, min tihthinur avângin chutiang chuan ka mite chu ka sawisa dâwn a ni,” a ti a.

en: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
mz: “A ran ruala a pa awm renga, thu pawh tiama, Lalpa hnêna a hmêlhem hlâna bumtu chu ânchhe dawng a ni; Kei chu Lal ropui tak ka ni si a, ka hming pawh Jentail-te zîngah A ?ihawm a ni,” Sipaihote Lalpa chuan a ti.

en: This is the work of the cross and resurrection.
mz: Hei hi kraws leh thawhlehna hnathawh a ni a.

en: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
mz: Tin, chu mi hmun hmingah chuan Bethel a vuah a: a khaw hming erawh chu a tîrah chuan Luz a ni.

en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
mz: Tin, mipa inzuarhote chu a ram ata a hnawt chhuak a, a putena milem an lo siam zawng zawngte chu a thehthang bo vek a.

en: [Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite]. I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
mz:
Lalpa, i ngilneihzia zaiin ka chawi ang a,
I rinawmzia ka hril kumkhua bawk ang.

en:
Try speaking to Satan in this way. When you use
the blood in this way, Satan is defeated and he knows it. Revela-
tion 12:10-11 says, “The accuser of our brothers has been cast
down.…And they overcame him because of the blood of the
Lamb and because of the word of their testimony.” The word
of your testimony is just your declaration that the blood of
Jesus Christ has cleansed you from every sin and that this
blood has defeated Satan. When you speak boldly in this way,
Satan’s accusations are overcome.
mz:
Hetiang hian
Setana hnenah chuan sawi tum ang che. Heti zawnga thisen chu i hman
chuan, Setana chu hnehin a awm tawh a chu chu a hre bawk a ni.
Thupuan 12:10-11 chuan, “Kan unaute hektu ... chu an paihthla ta si
a... Beram no thisen avâng leh an hriatpuina (testimony) thu avângin
ani chu an hneh a ni,” a ti a. I hriatpuina thu chu Isua Krista thisenin
sual tinreng lak ata a tlengfai tawh che a, tichuan, he thisen hian Setana
a hneh tawh a ni tih i puanchhuah mai kha a ni. Hetianga huaisen taka
i sawi chuan Setana hekna chu hnehin a awm dawn a ni.

en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the loins, and the caul upon the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away,
mz: a kal te leh a bawhtu thau te, a thin hlâwm ṭha lai hlehte chu

en: and the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
mz: Ekron khaw hmâr lam tlâng a zui a, Sikeron lamah a inher a, Baala tlâng pêlin Jamnia khua a thleng a, chuta ṭangin Mediteranean tuipuiah a tâwp a.

en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
mz: Tichuan pungkhawmho zawng zawng chuan, chutianga tih chu an duh a, mi zawng zawng ngaiha thil dik a ni reng a.

en: Rather, he showed the attitude described at Psalm 141:5: “Should the righteous one strike me , it would be a loving-kindness; and should he reprove me , it would be oil upon the head, which my head would not want to refuse.”
mz: Sâm 141: 5-a thu sawi: “Mi fel chuan mi vaw rawh se, khawngaihna a ni ang; mi zilhhau rawh se, lûa hriak thih ang a ni ang; ka lûin duh lo suh se,” tih ang rilru put hmang a lantîr zâwk mah a ni.

en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come in peace unto his own house.
mz: Mefiboseta chuan lal hnênah, “Ziba chuan ram chu nei vek rawh se, ka pu lal chu ama in ngeiah râlmuang takin a lo thleng tawh si a,” a ti a.

en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
mz: Tin, Assuria lal chuan Tartan te, Rabsari te leh Rabsake te sipai tam tak nen Lakis khua atangin Jerusalem khuaa lal Jezekia hnênah chuan a tir a. Tin, Jerusalem khua chu an han thleng a. Tin, an han thlen chuan puan sutu phul kalkawnga dil chakta zâwk tuilakna kiangah chuan an ding a.

en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went unto their tents.
mz: Tichuan, Josuan mal a sâwm a, a hawtîr a; in lamah an haw ta a.

en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
mz: Chutichuan Uzia chu api leh a pute hnênah chuan a muhil a, lal inphûmna hmuna a pi leh a pute zingah an phûm a, “Ani zawng phar a ni si a,” an ti a: tin, a fapa Jothama chu a aiah a lal ta a.

en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
mz: Chutichuan Sealtiela fapa Zerubabela leh Jozadaka fapa Jesua chuan Jerusalem-a Pathian in chu an han bei tan leh ta a; tin, an hnêna chuan anmahni tanpuiin Pathian zâwlneite chu an awm a.

en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
mz: LALPA, i ding lama awm chuan A thinur niah chuan lalte a sat chhum rem rum ang.

en: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, that come near to minister unto Jehovah; and it shall be a place for their houses, and a holy place for the sanctuary.
mz: Hmun thianghlim bîk a ni a, Hmun Thianghlima Lalpa rawngbâwltu puithiamte tân a ni, an insakna tûr leh biakbûk sakna tûr a ni.

en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
mz: A hnathawh chu Pathian ina rawngbawla Arona fapate tanpuia kawt hung hchung leh pindan chhûnga thil thianghlim zawng zawng tihthianghlim a, LALPA ina rawngbawl a ni si a;

en: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
mz: Efraim thlah, in unaute ka hnawt chhuak vek ang khân nangni pawh ka hnên ata ka hnawt chhuak dâwn che u a ni.”

en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
mz: LALPA chu ka chakna leh ka phaw a ni a Ka thinlung hian mah chu a ring a, tichuan puihin ka awm a; Chuvangin ka thinlung hi nasa takin a hlim a; Ka hlain amah ka fak a.

en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
mz: Tin, lal chuan puithiam lal ber Jehoiada chu a ko va, a hnênah, “Engati nge Levi-hote chu LALPA chhiahhlawh Mosia le Israel mipuite ruat hriattirna puan in atâna thawh bi ruat chu Juda mi leh Jerusalem=a mite thawh tûrin i phut loh?

en: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
mz: Hnam dangte chu an chuai ang a, An kulhbing ata te chu khur chungin an lo chhuak ang.

en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?
mz: Tin, Lalpa Pathian chuan heti hian a ti a ni: Hmasânga ka rawngbâwltu Israel zâwlnei, chûng laia kum tam tak chhûnga thu lo sawi ?hîntuten, anmahni bei tûra ka rawn hruai tûr thu an sawi ?hina kha i ni em, ti rawh,” tiin.

en: And the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

en:
Second Corinthians 3:16 says, “Whenever their heart turns 
to the Lord, the veil is taken away.” The heart must first be
turned to the Lord. This is real repentance. When we were fallen, 
our heart was turned away from the Lord. But when we re-
pented, our heart was turned to the Lord. This matter of turn-
ing the heart to the Lord is not done once for all. The heart 
must be turned to the Lord all the time, day by day. Every morn-
ing we must turn our heart again toward the Lord. After rising, 
we should go to the Lord and tell Him, “Lord, here I am. By 
Your mercy and grace I wish to turn my heart anew to You for 
this day.”
mz:
2 Korinth 3:16 chuan heti hian a sawi a, “Nimahsela, an thinlung
chu Lalpa lam a hawi tik apiangin khuhna chu lâk bo a ni tawh ang.”
Thinlung chu Lalpa lam hawi hmasa ber tûr a ni. Hei hi simna tak tak
chu a ni. Kan tlûk chuan, kan thinlung chu Lalpa aṭangin a hawi sawn
daih ṭhin a. Kan sim hunah erawh chuan, kan thinlung chuan Lalpa lam
a hawi a. He thil, thinlungin Lalpa lam a hawi hi vawikhat chauh a tâwk
lo. Thinlung chu Lalpa lamah englai pawh in, nitin in a hawi tûr a ni.
Zing tin kan thinlung chu Lalpa lamah, Lalpa hnenah kalin, heti hian
Amah chu kan hrilh tûr a ni. “Lalpa, heta hi ka awm a. I zahngaihna
leh khawngaihna avangin vawiin ni atan hian ka thinlung chu a tharin i
lam hawi tir ka duh,” tiin.

en: Revelation 21:3 says, “And I heard a loud voice out of the throne,saying,Behold,thetabernacleofGodiswithmen,and He will tabernacle with them, and they will be His peoples, and God Himself will be with them and be their God.” This verse reveals what it will be like in the new heaven and new earth.Thenewheavenandnewearthareintheeternalbless- ing, and positive blessing is spoken of here. This verse is followed by statements that say there will be no more of this and no more of that. These are the negative aspects, not the positive aspects.What is the positive and eternal blessing? It isthatGodwillbewithus.ThepresenceofGodistheblessing. All that the Scriptures have ever said about the blessing in eternity is summed up in these words, “God Himself will be withthem.”TheseverestsufferingistobewithoutGod’spres- ence. But all of the enjoyment in eternity will be God’s presence.The blessing of that day,is nothing other than God being with us. Solomon once said, “Behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?” (1 Kings 8:27). The heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Him, but we may say that the New Jerusalem can contain Him. God dwells in the New Jerusalem, and God’s throne is established there.
mz: He châng hian vân thar leh lei thar chu engangnge anih ang tih a puangchhuak a. Vn thar leh lei thar chu chatuan malsawmnaa awm leh malsawmnaa hriatchian a nih thu a sawi chhuak a. Hemi châng hian chutiang thil a awm tawh dawn loh thuin a chhunzawm a ni. HÊngte hi thil nilo lam thlirna zawn a ni a, a ni lam thlirna zawn a ni lo. Anih leh a ni lam leh chatuan malsawmna chu engnge ni ang? Pathian kan hnêna a awm tur chu a ni. Pathian hmaa awm chu malsawmna a ni. Pathian thu in chatuana malsawmna a sawi reng reng funkhawmna chu, “Pathian chu an hnênah A awm ang,” tih hi a ni. Tuarna hautak ber mai chu Pathian awmpui lohna hi a ni. Chatuana hlimna chen tur zawng zawng erawh chu Pathian awmpuinaah a ni dawn a ni. Chumi nia malsawmna chu thildang ni lovin Pathian kan hnêna awm tur chu a ni. Solomona chuan vawikhat chu heti hian a sawi a, “Ngai teh, vân leh vânte vânah pawh i leng lo a ni a; he ka insakah hian i va leng lo nasa lehzual awm em!” (1 Lalte 8:27). mz: Ani chuan, “Tangka sâng pawh mi pe dâwn mah la, lal fapa chu ka that chuang lo vang, ka hriat lai ngeiin lalin i hnênah te, Abisaia hnênah te, Itaia hnênahte, ‘Tlangvâl Absaloma chu tu man khawih suh ang che u!’ a tih kha.

Ngai teh u, in thu ka nghâk reng a,
Sawi tûr in dap chhûng khân

Eng mah a ni ta lo,
Gilgal-ah pawh bâwng lem an bia a,

Lung paih khâwm ang mai a la ni ang.

Judai ram mite chu hrehawm tuarin salah an tâng,
Hnam dang zîngah an awm darh a,
Hahchawlhna rêng an hmu zo lo.

Hêng mite erawh hi chu mahni awh nâna thang kam an ni,

en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it. And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
mz: Jerusalem khawlaiahte tlan vêl ula, En ula, chhinchhiah ula a mual zawlte zawng ula, Mi pakhat tal fel taka tia, thutak zawng reng in hmuh theih chuan, Jerusalem chu ka ngaidam ang. LALPA a nuna a nun chung chu, ti mah sela, Dawtin chhia an chham mai a ni.

en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
