Ruhkawl leh vun mai ka ni ta,
Ka nung chang chang a ni.

en: (Deuteronomy 5:18; Proverbs 6:29-35; Hebrews 13:4) Temptation to lie, to be dishonest , or to steal can be successfully suppressed by complying with divine reminders.
mz: (Deuteronomy 5:18; Thufingte 6: 29-35; Hebrai 13:4) Dâwt sawi tûr te, rinawm lo tûr te, a nih loh leh rûk ru tûr tea thlêmnate chu Pathian thuhriattîrte zawmna hmangin a hneh theih a ni.

en: And ye shall see [it], and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the tender grass: and the hand of Jehovah shall be known toward his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.
mz:
Chu chu in hmuh hunah lâwmin in harh huai huai ang a,
Hnim chawrno angin in duah leh ang.
Kei Lalpa hian ka chhiahhlawhte ka pui ṭhîn a,
Ka hmêlmate chungah ka thinur ṭhîn tih in hria ang.

en: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
mz: Tin, Dvida chuan LALPAN Israel mite chunga lalah amah chu a tinghet a, a mi Israelte a vangin ram chu a chawimawi ani tih a hre ta a.

en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
mz: Naupangte lamin mi hmusit a, Ka han tho hi mi eu va.

en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
mz: Ka bikbosan ang a, Engtin nge an awm dawn tehreng,’ a ti: Chhuan bengtlalo an ni, Rin kai lo fanute.

en: The effects of the cursed ground, with its thorns and thistles, were so keenly felt by Adam’s descendants that Noah’s father, Lamech, spoke of ‘the pain of their hands resulting from the ground which Jehovah had cursed .’ —Genesis 3:17-19; 5:29.
mz: Lei ânchhe lawh avânga lo awm hlîng leh buarte avângin, Adama thlah Nova pa, Lameka chuan ‘Lalpa ânchhe lawh lei avânga an hna thawhna leh kuta an thawh rimna’ thu a sawi a ni. —Genesis 3: 17-19; 5:29.

en: These are among the spiritual provisions that God has made for those concerning whom Isaiah prophesied: “It must occur in the final part of the days that the mountain of the house of Jehovah will become firmly established above the top of the mountains , and it will certainly be lifted up above the hills; and to it all the nations must stream.
mz: Hêng hi Isaia hrilh lâwknain a sawiate tâna Pathian buatsaih thlarau lam chawte zînga mi a ni. Isaia chuan: “Ni hnuhnûngahte chuan heti hi a ni ang a, LALPA in awmna tlâng chu tlâng lian chungahte chuan tihnghehin a awm ang a, tlâng tête chungah chuan chawisânin a awm bawk ang; chutah chuan hnam tinrêngte chu an kal nguah nguah ang.

en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal To satisfy himself when he is hungry:
mz:
Rilṭâm avânga thil rutu chu
Miten an hmusit lem lo.

en: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.
mz: a rilru a unaute chungah a dah lo va ding lama emaw, vei lamah emaw, thupêk chu a pensan lohna tur leh Israelte zinga amah leh a thlahte a ramah hian an dam rei phah nan a chhiar thin tur a ni.

en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
mz: Aigupta mite awm dân ka let ang a, an pianna ram, Pathros ramah ka kîrtîr ang; tin, tah chuan tlâwm takin an lal ang.

en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
mz:
Bân chau tawhte chu tichak ula,
Khûp khûr tawhte pawh tichak rawh u.

en: (1 Timothy 2:6) In effect, God used the value of Jesus’ life to buy back, or redeem, the human race from slavery to sin and death.
mz: (1 Timothea 2: 6, NW) Pathianin Isua nun hlu tak chu mihringte sual leh thihna bâwih ata lei chhuah nân, a nih loh leh chhan chhuah nân a hmang a ni.

en: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
mz: LALPA chu ka chakna leh ka hla a ni, Ani chu ka chhandamna a lo ni ta bawk a: Ka Pathian a ni a, amah chu ka fak ang; Ka pa Pathian a ni a, amah chu ka chawimawiang.

en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
mz:
Mit nei si-a mitdelte leh,
Beng nei si-a bengngawngte chu han khâwm rawh u.

en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
mz: Nethin-ho erawh chu Ophel-ah an awm a. Ziha leh Gispa chu Nethin-ho hotu an ni a.

en: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and a hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
mz: Joaba chuan Israel mi zât chu a hrilh a, “Sipaia ṭang thei mi maktaduaikhat leh nuaikhat Israel ramah an awm a, Judai ramah mi nuai li leh sîngsarih an awm,” a ti a.

en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
mz: Chutih lai chuan he mite leh Jerusalem hnênah, “Thlalêr tlâng kawlh vul ata thli lum tak, Ka fanu, ka mite zap fai tûr ni lo, thliar fai tûr ni hek lo,

en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and spake these words in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
mz: Tin, zualkote chuan Saula awmna Gibea khua an va thleng a, mipui hnênah chuan chu thu chu an hrilh a. Mi zawng zawng chu mangangin an ṭap ta chuah chuah a.

en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits; Of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.
mz:
Lalpa hriakthih, kan belh ber chu,
An thangah chuan a âwk ta si.
‘Ama hovin hnam dang kârahte pawh,
Kan awm ang chu,’ kan lo ti ṭhîn.

en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
mz: “In zingah mikhual leh pêm mai ka ni a: ka mitthi ruang hi ka hmuh lohva ka phûm theihna tûrin in zîngah hian phumna hmun ro mi pe rawh u,” tiin a sawi a.

en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
mz: Manasea fapate chu, a nupuiin Asriela a hring a, (a hmeinu Aram miin Gileada pa Makira a hring a;

en: And Jehovah said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore art thou thus fallen upon thy face?
mz: Lalpa chuan Josua hnênah, “Tho teh, bawk reng teh suh,

en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
mz: Tin, heng hi Gersoma fapate hming chu a ni: Libnia leh Simeia.

en: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
mz: Tin, Pathianin ni sarih niah chuan a thil siam chu a ti zo va: ni sarih niah chuan a thil siam zawng zawng chu a chawlhsan ta a.

en: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.
mz: Lalpa chuan mei a rawn tîr a, rimtui hâltu mi zahnih leh sawmngate chu a rawn kâng hlum ta vek a.

en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
mz: Abrama chu Kanaan ramah chuan a awm a, Lota chu Phaizâwl khuaahte chuan a awm a, a puan in chu Sodom khaw thlengin a sawn zêl a.

en: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, he that walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:
mz: “Efesi khaw kohhran tirhkoh hnênah heti hian ziak rawh: ‘A kut ding lama arsi pasarih kenga, rangkachak khâwnvâr dahna pasarih zînga vei veia khân heti hian a ti:

en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
mz: tin, tupawh heng ruang latu apiangte hian an puante an su tur a ni a, tlai lam thlengin an bawlhhlawh ang,

en: (Ephesians 4:25) Earlier, the prophet Zechariah wrote: “Speak truthfully with one another.”
mz: (Ephesi 4:25) Chu mi hma pawhin, zâwlnei Zakaria pawhin: “Mi tinin mahni ṭhenawm hnênah thudik tak sawi ṭheuh ula,” tiin a lo ziak bawk.

en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
mz: Tin, Josua leh Israel-ho zawng zawngte chu Debir khaw lamah an let leh a; an bei ta a:

en: who shall suffer punishment, [even] eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
mz: Chûngte chu Lalpa hma ata leh a thiltihtheihna ropui tak lak ata kumkhaw chhiatnaah chuan paih an ni ang a.

en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
mz: “Atarot te, Dibon te, Jazer te, Nimra te, Hesbon te, Elealeh te, Sebam te, Nebo te, Beon ram te,

en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
mz: Chutichuan Saula dam chhûng zawng zawng chuan Philistia mite nen nasa tak maiin asn indo thin a: tin, Saula chuan mi chak emaw, mi huai emaw a hmuh apiang chu a la zel thin a ni.

en: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help [us] in time of need.
mz: Chutichuan, puih kan ngaih hun taka zahngaihna leh khawngaihna kan hmuh theihna tûrin, khawngaihna lalṭhutthlêng chu huai takin i hnaih ang u.

en: (Galatians 5:22, 23) No matter what your circumstances are, you will be happy as long as you imitate Jehovah’s generous personality and are one of his precious fellow workers ! —Proverbs 3:9, 10.
mz: (Galatia 5:22, 23) I dinhmun chu engpawh ni se, Jehova thilphalna mizia i entawn a, a hnathawhpuite zînga mi i nih reng chuan i hlim ang!—Thufingte 3:9, 10.

en: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard? The everlasting God, Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary; there is no searching of his understanding.
mz:
In hre na nge?
Lalpa chauh hi chatuan Pathian chu a ni a,
Kâwlkil hual chhûnga awm zawng zawng hi Ama siam vek a ni.
A chau lo va, a hah ngai bawk hek lo.
A finzia pawh tu mah hre phâk an awm loh hi,
In hre ngai lo vem ni?

en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of Jehovah their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
mz: Juda-ho pawh chuan an Pathian, Lalpa thupêkte chu an zâwm chuang bîk lo, Israel-te tih dân kha an la ve zêl zâwk a.

en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
mz: rorêl thuah te, tehna hmawlhah te, khinah te, tehnaah te fel lo takin in ti tur a ni lo.

en: I say then, Did God cast off his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
mz: A nih leh, Pathian chuan a mite chu a paih thla kan ti dâwn em ni? Paih thla suh e. Kei ngei pawh Israel mi, Abrahama thlah, Benjamin hnam ka ni si a.

en: who also made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
mz: Ani chuan Thuthlung Thar rawngbâwl tlâkah min siam a, chu chu Dân, hawrawpa ziak ang kha a ni lo ve; Thuthlung Thar, Thlarauva ziak chu a ni zâwk. Dân, hawrawpa ziak khân thihna a thlen a, Thlarauva ziak erawh chuan nunna a thlen a ni.

en: insomuch that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that, as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some one of them.
mz: Chutichuan, dam lote pawh kawtthlêrahte an zâwn chhuak a, khumah te, mutphahah te an muttîr a. Petera hlim chuan a kal vêl pahin an zînga ṭhenkhat tal a hliah theih nân an ti a ni.

en: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way, because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them that seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
mz: ‘Kan Pathian chuan amah ringtu apiangte chu mal a sâwm ṭhîn a, amah hawisantute erawh chu a lâwm lo va, a hrem ṭhîn’ tiin lal chu ka lo hrilh ṭhin avângin kalkawnga râl laka min vêngtu tûr sakawr chungchuang sipai rual ka dîl zak a ni.

en: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
mz: Tin, nang, mihring fapa, i hnam fate hnênah chuan sawi la, ‘Mi fel felna chuan a bawhchhiatna nîah chuan amah chu a chhanhim lo vang a, mi suaksual sualna pawhin a suahsualna a hawisan nîah chuan a titlu lo vang a, mi fel lah chu a sualna nîah chuan a felnain a nung thei bîk hek lo vang.’

en: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a standard: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he seeth it, shall live.
mz: Lalpa chuan Mosia hnênah, “Dârin rûl lem siam la, mi tin hmuh theih tûrin thingtlâwn lêrah khai rawh; rûl chuk apiangin chu chu an en chuan an dam zêl ang,” a ti a.

en: Cease, my son, to hear instruction [Only] to err from the words of knowledge.
mz:
Ka fapa, thununna i zir zawm loh chuan,
I hriat sa pawh i theihnghilh mai ang.

en: who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him: yea, thou spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thy hand, as it is this day.
mz: Ka pa Davida hnênah i thutiam i hlen a, vawiin hian i tipuitling ta a ni.

en: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
mz: rangkachak berhbu sawmhnih, darik sângkhat theuh; dar tle mi mawi tak, rangkachak ang maia hlu bungbêl pahnih a ni a.

en: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
mz: Lebanon atangin lo kal ang che, ka thiannu, ka hnênah, Lebanon atangin ka hnênah: Amana chhipah chuan rawn chuan la; Senir leh Hermon chhip atang chuan, Sakeibaknei puk atang chuanin Keitete tlâng atang pawhin.

en: Because thou servedst not Jehovah thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
mz: malsâwmna tinrêngin a vûr che u a, hlim leh lâwm taka Lalpa, in Pathian rawng chu bâwl tûr in ni asin.

en: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck and kissed him,
mz: An vaiin an ṭap ta a, Paula nghâwngah an kuah a, an fâwp ngawih ngawih a.

en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
mz:
Mipa takin i puanven sawi chhîng la,
Thu ka zâwt ang che a, mi chhâng ang che.

en: If not, hearken thou unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will teach thee wisdom.
mz:
Sawi tûr i nei lo a nih leh mi ngaithla la,
Lo ngawi la, finna ka zirtîr ang che.

en: Unquestionably , Satan and the demons mislead people “with every powerful work and lying signs and portents and with every unrighteous deception for those who are perishing.” —2 Thessalonians 2:9, 10.
mz: Rinhelhrual lohvin, Setana leh a ramhuaite chuan mite chu “thiltihtheihna tinrêng te, chhinchhiahna tinrêng te, dâwt thilmak tinrêng te . . . boral mêkte tân fel lohna bumna tinrêng nên” an bum a ni.—2 Thessalonika 2:9, 10.

en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
mz:
An fanu te, an fapa te,
Ramhuai hnêna inthawi nân an hmang ta a.

en: The anger of Jehovah hath scattered them; He will no more regard them: They respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.
mz:
Lalpa a thinur a, a tidarh ta a ni,
A ngaihsak tawh hauh lo,
Puithiam a duhsak chuang lo va,
Kan upate a khawngaih bawk hek lo.

en: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
mz: Juda lal Salluma, Josia fapa, a pa Josia aia rorêltu, he hmun ata kal chhuak ta chungchang thu chu LALPAN heti hian a sawi: Hetah hian a lo kir leh tawh lo vang.

en: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
mz: Tin, ani chuan a hnênah, “Chuti tûr chu ni lo ve, hetianga dik lo taka mi tihchhuah hi ka chunga i tih tak ai mah khan a tha lo zawk a ni, a ti a. Nimahsela a pawm duh chuang lo va.

en: For all his ordinances were before me; And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
mz:
Awm dân tûra a tih zawng zawng ka pawisa a,
A thuruatte chu ka zâwm lo ngai lo.

en: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, Jehovah, he is God; Jehovah, he is God.
mz: Mipuiin chu chu an hmuhin leiah an bawkkhup a, “Lalpa hi Pathian chu a ni, Lalpa hi Pathian chu a lo ni ngei e,” tiin an au chhuak a.

en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
mz: Hmâsânga kan pute hnêna chhia i chham tawh, Jakoba hnêna thutak leh Abrahama hnêna khawngaihna chu i hlen ang.

en: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child: and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
mz: “Tin, unaupa in a unaupa tihhlum tûrin a mantîr ang a, pa pawhin a fa a mantîr ang; fate pawhin an nu leh pate an do vang a, an tihlum ang.

en: and they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Jehovah, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
mz: Saula leh a fapa Jonathana te leh Lalpa mi, Israel-te chu khandaiha an thah avângin an sûn a, an ṭah a, tlai thlengin chaw an nghei a.

en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; And the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
mz:
Rilru nei rên râwnten hriatna an neih belh a,
Mi fingte chuan hriatna an ngaihven ṭhîn.

en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
mz: Bela a thih chuan Bozra khaw mi Zera fapa Jobaba chuan a ai a awh a.

en: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
mz: Mihring taksa ah chuan leih tur a ni lo va, he mi siam dân anga siam, a ang tak hian in siam tur a ni hek lo: hei hi zawng a thianghlima, tichuan in tân thil thianghlim a ni tur a ni.

en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
mz: Simeona hnam zinga mi Horia fapa Saphata.

en: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
mz: Tin, Mosia chuan Paran thlaler atang chuan LALPA thupêk angin a kaltir ta hlawm a: an za chuan Israel thlahte zinga puipa thiau an ni.

en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.
mz:
An hriat loh hlânin hlobet anga ah chhum an ni,
A thi leh dam, Pathian thinurnain a lên bo vang,

en: (Proverbs 13:20a) Thus they come to understand “the entire course of what is good” and avoid needless problems and pains. —Proverbs 2:6-9; Psalm 1:1-3.
mz: (Thufingte 13:20a) Chuvângin, “kawng ṭha tinrêng” chu hre thiamin, ṭûl lo taka buaina leh rilru natna chu an pumpelh a ni.—Thufingte 2:6-9; Sâm 1:1-3.

en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill the sin-offering in the place of burnt-offering.
mz: Kêl lu-ah a kut a nghat ang a, hâlral maichâm hmâr lamah hâlral thilhlan an talhna hmunah chuan a talh tûr a ni.

en: For who will have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who will bemoan thee? or who will turn aside to ask of thy welfare?
mz:
“Aw Jerusalem, tu nge khawngaih ang che?
Tu nge ṭah ang che?
‘Eng nge i chanchin?’ tiin tu nge chiauau ang che?

en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
mz: Tin, Ezra fapate chu Jethera te, Mereda te, Ephera te, Jalona te an ni; tin, Pharaoa fanu Bithiaii Mereda nupui fapate chu Miriama te, Samaia te, Estemoa pa Isba te an ni.

en: It is quite probable, then, that the long period of eighteen years of our Lord’s life, from the time of the incident [recorded at Luke 2:41-49] to the time of his baptism, was spent in the performance of the ordinary duties of life.”
mz: Chuvângin, kan Lalpa nun kum 18 chhûng, [Luka 2:41-49 a chhinchhiah] thil thlen hun aṭanga baptisma a chan thleng chu nuna thil tih tûr pângngaite tiin a nun a hmang liam a ni tia ngaihdân neih chu a âwm hle a ni,” tiin a sawi a ni.

en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
mz: Mipuite chu Seir tlânga awm, Esauva thlah in unaute ramah in kal tlang dawn a ni; anni chuan an lo hlau vang che u a; chuvangin fimkhur hle ula;

en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
mz:
A pa bawhchhiatna chu Lalpan hre reng sela,
A nu suahsualna pawh thai bo ni hek suh se.

en: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
mz:
Lalpa, kan chhehvêla chêngten an chêksawlhna che chu,
A lêt sarih ngawtin rûl rawh.

en: Which of the two did the will of his father? They say, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, that the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
mz: Chu mite pahnih chu a tu zâwk chuan nge an pa duhzâwng ti le?” a ti a. Anni chuan, “A hmasa zâwk chuan,” an ti a. Isuan an hnênah, “Thu dik ka hrilh a che u, chhiahkhawntute leh nawhchizuarte chuan Pathian ram an luh khalh ta che u a nih hi.

en: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it were better for me to be there still. Now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be iniquity in me, let him kill me.
mz: Absaloma chuan Joaba chu a chhâng a, “Ka hnêna lo kala, lal hnênah, “Eng atân nge Gesur ata ka lo hâwn? Chutah chuan awm reng ila, ka tân a ṭha zâwk tûr,’ tia sawi tûrin ka chah che a ni lâwm ni? Tûnah, lal hnênah min hruai la, thil ka tisual a nih chuan min that mai rawh se,” a ti a.

en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
mz:
Thal bâwm chutianga khat nei chu an nihlawh e,
Kulh kawngkaa hmêlma an tawn hunah
An mualpho hauh lo vang.

en: according to the commandment of Jehovah they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
mz: Lalpa thupêk angin a duhthlan Timnat-sera khua an pe a, Efraim tlângrama awm a ni; khua chu a din ṭha a, a awm ta a.

en: and say, O Jehovah, thou hast spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that none shall dwell therein, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
mz: Hetiangin sawi ang che, ‘Aw Lalpa, he hnam hi tihchhiat i tum thu i lo sawi tawh a; chuvângin, tu mah, mihring leh ramsa pawh, a chhûngah an chêng tawh lo vang a, kumkhuain a ram dêr tawh ang,’ ti ang che.

en: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
mz: sângha mantute pawh chu an tap ang a, Nile luia nghakawi khai thinte zawng zawngte chu an awm an inchum chau tawh ang.

en: (Zephaniah 3:3, 4) How well those words fit the situation of Christendom’s prophets and priests today!
mz: (Zephania 3: 3, 4) Hêng thute hian tûn lai Kristianna rama zâwlneite leh puithiamte a va chawih tak êm!

en: And other fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
mz: A ṭhen hnimhlîngnei zîngah a tla a, hnim chu a lo ṭhang a, a dîp ral a, a rah thei ta lo va.

en: And she brought up one of her whelps: he became a young lion, and he learned to catch the prey; he devoured men.
mz:
Kawlh tak pakhat a châwm lian a,
A puitlin chuan sa a seh thei hle a,
Mihring pawh a seh ta a.

en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
mz: Tin, Moab mite a bei leh a, leiah a muttir a, tehna hruiin a teh a; tlar hnihchu tihhlum tûrin a teh a, tlar khat chu a tluana nunga zuh tûrin a teh a. Tichuan Moab mite chu Davida chhiah khua an lo ni ta a, hhiahte an pe thin a.

en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
mz: An suk lohva an inbual loh phei chuan an khawlohna mawh chu an phur ang, ka ti a,’ ti rawh” tiin.

en: For many nations and great kings shall make bondmen of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.
mz: Hnam tam tak leh ram ropui tak takte chuan anni chu salah an siam ang a, an thil lo tih tawh leh an kut hnathawh ang zêlin ka thungrûl ang.”

en: And Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
mz: Israel lal Jehoasa chuan Juda lal Amazia, Joasa fapa, Ahazia tupa chu a man a, Jerusalem-ah a hruai a; khawpui kulh bang chu ‘Efraim kawngkhâr aṭanga bangkil kawngkhâr’ an tih thlengin kulh bang tawng zali chu a ṭhiat a.

en: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
mz: “Tho la, bêlvawtu inah zu kal la, tah chuan thu ka hrilh ang che,” a ti a.

en: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and the voice which I heard [was] as [the voice] of harpers harping with their harps:
mz: Vân aṭang chuan tuifinriat ri ang leh khawpui ri dur dur ang thâwm ka hria a, ka thâwm hriat chu ṭingṭang tum miten an ṭingṭang an tum ri ang a ni.

en: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
mz: Josua chuan hnam tin aṭanga Israel miten an thlan chhuah mi sâwm leh pahnihte chu a ko va,

en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
mz: Vante ka khâr a, ruahte a sur loh emaw, ka mite zinga hri ka lentir emaw a,

en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies that gave thanks and went in procession; [whereof one went] on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
mz: Judai rama hotute chu kulh bang chung zâwlah chuan ka hruai a, pâwl hnihah an inṭhen a. Khawpui kulh bang chung zâwlah chuan Pathian fak chungin an kal kual a. Pâwl khat chu bang chung zâwla kalin Bawlhhlawh Kawngkhâr lam, ding lam panin an kal a.

en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
mz: Harim khaw chhuak mi zathum leh sawmhnih;

en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
mz: Mi â chuan hriatnaah lawmna a nei lo, Ama rilruin a tihlan chauh lo chu.

en: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
mz: Tin, rangkachak zai phiar pahnih leh rangkachak khang pahnih an siam a; tichuan awmbel tlâng hmawr ve veah chuan khangte chu an vuah a.

en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
mz: I sumdâwngtute chu vân arsi aia tamin i tipung a: thingngêtin a thla a zâra, a thlâwk bo ang hian an bo zo ta.

en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
mz: a ka pahnih leh a bawhtu thau, a nema mi leh a thin tuamtu râng, a kalte chawpin a phawrh ang a;

en: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
mz:
Vaivutah ka tlu reng mai a,
I tiam angin min tiharh rawh.

en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
mz: Anmahni i pêk an chhar thin a; I kut i phar a, thatnain an tlai thin.

en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
mz: Tin, Mosia chuan Gada thlahte leh Reubena thlahte leh Josefa ta Manasea thlah hnam chanve te chu Amor lal Sihona ram te, Basan lal Oga ram, chung ramte chu a khaw awm zawng zawng nen, a vel ram khuate nen lam a pe a.

en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
mz: Tin, hmar lampanga an ramri chin chu Jordan atangin a ni: tin, ramri chu Jeriko sirah hmar lampangah a chho zel a, tin, thlang lampangan tlâng ramah a chho zel a; ramri tawpna chu Beth-aven thlalerah a ni.

en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
mz: An puan inte, an ran rualte an laksak ang, An puanzar te, an bungbêl zawng zawng te, An sanghawngseite chu an kal bopui ang, Kil tinah hlauhawm a awm, Tiin miten an au khum ang.

en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
mz: A lal tantirh chuan kum sâwmhnih leh kum nga mi a ni a, Jerusalem-ah kum kum sâwmhnih leh kum kuaa lal a; anu hming chu Jehoadini, Jerusalem mi a ni.

en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
mz: In ei bâng chu zîng thlengin a awm tûr a ni lo; chutiang ei bâng in neih chuan in rawh ral tûr a ni.

en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging-place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
mz:
Khualzinte tân thlalêrah thlenna khualbûk awm sela,
Ka mite ka kalsan ang a, ka inthiarfihlîm daih tûr.
An vaiin an uire a, bumhmang awm khâwm an ni.

en: And it will come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of Jehovah will carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he will slay me: but I thy servant fear Jehovah from my youth.
mz: Ka kalsan hnu chein Lalpa Thlarauvin ka hriat lohna lamah a hruai daih ang che a, Ahaba ka va hrilha, a hmuh si loh che chuan min that mai dâwn asin. Kei i chhiahhlawh hi ka tleirâwl chhuah ata Lalpa betu ka ni a.

en: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a sojourner, an Amalekite.
mz: Davida chuan chûng thu rawn hrilhtu tlangvâl hnênah chuan, “Khawi lam mi nge i nih?” a ti a. Ani chuan, “Ram dang mi, Amalek hnam ka ni,” a ti a.

en: ( Acts 7:21-25; Hebrews 11:24, 25) When this incident became known, Egypt’s royal house viewed Moses as an outlaw, and he had to flee for his life.
mz: (Tirhkohte 7: 21-25; Hebrai 11: 24, 25) He thilthleng hi mite’n an lo hriat chuan, Aigupta lal chhûngkua chuan Mosia chu hel anga a ngaih avângin, a nunna atân a tlânchhiat a ngai ta a ni.

en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
mz: Tin, chu mi atân khânvâr pasarih I siam tûr a ni: tichuan khawnvarte chu an dah ang a, a hma zâwnte chu a ên theih nân.

en: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
mz: Tin, heti hi a ni ang a, mawisawla rimtui tak aiah thil tawih a awm ang; tin, kawnghren aiah hruizen a awm ang; tin, sam hniar siau aiah lu kawlhna a awm ang ; tin, puan mawi tak aiah saiip puan ven a awm ang: hmêl that aiah thir linga deh chhiatna a awm ang.

en: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be deferred any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord Jehovah.
mz: Chuvângin, an hnênah sawi rawh: Lalpa Pathian chuan heti hian a ti: “Ka thu sawi rêng rêng a muangchâng lo vang: ka sawi chu tih nghâl a ni ang, Lalpa Pathian thuchhuak chuan a ti, ti rawh,” min ti a.

en: And the disciples went, and did even as Jesus appointed them,
mz: Tichuan, zirtîrte chu an va kal a, Isuan thu a pêk ang ngeiin an ti a.

en: Thou hast heard it; behold all this; and ye, will ye not declare it? I have showed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, which thou hast not known.
mz:
Hêng hi in hmu a, in hre ta a,
A dik in ti lâwm ni?
Tûn aṭangin thil thar ka hrilh dâwn a che u,
In hriat loh thil inthupte chu.

en: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money , self-assuming, haughty, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, disloyal, having no natural affection, not open to any agreement, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, without love of goodness, betrayers, headstrong, puffed up with pride, lovers of pleasures rather than lovers of God.” —2 Timothy 3:1-5.
mz: Mi, mahni inhmangaihtu te, tangka ngainatu te, intivei te, chapo te, Pathian sawichhetu te, nu leh pa thuâwih lo te, lâwm nachâng hre lo te, thianghlim lo te, hmangaihna pianpui nei lo te, huaikawm bâwl te, hektu te, insûm thei lo te, mi kawlhsen te, ṭha duh hauh lo te, vervêk te, thuhnudâwn lo te, inngaihlu te, Pathian hmangaih aia mahni lâwmna mai hmangaih zâwktu te an ni dâwn si,” tiin a ziak a ni.—2 Timothea 3:1-5.

en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute unto their brethren.
mz: Tempul kudâm enkawl tûr chuan hêng mite hi ka dah a: Puithiam Selemia te, Dân thiam Zadoka te, Levia chi Pedaia te hi. Anni puituah Zakura fapa Hanana, Matania tupa chu ka dah bawk a. Anni hi an thawhpuite hnênah dik taka thil sem tûra ka rinte an ni.

en: He hath left his covert, as the lion; for their land is become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppressing [sword], and because of his fierce anger.
mz:
Hnehchhiahtu ngûnhnâm avâng leh
Pathian thinurna nasa tak avâng chuan
An chênna ram chu an chhuahsan ta,
Sakeibakneiin a pûk a rauhsan ang maiin.

en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
mz: Israel mi dang chu puithiamte leh Levia chi dangte nên Judai ram khawpui deuhvah te leh khaw tê deuhvah te mahni inah an awm a.

en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
mz: Tichuan, hmêlhem lovn i dak chhuak ngei ang:A ni, i nghet ang a, i hlau lo vang;

en: Happy art thou, O Israel: Who is like unto thee, a people saved by Jehovah, The shield of thy help, And the sword of thy excellency! And thine enemies shall submit themselves unto thee; And thou shalt tread upon their high places.
mz:
Aw Israel, i va nihlawh kher êm!
Nang ang rêng tu mah an awm lo,
Lalpa chhandam hnam i ni a,
I himna tûr leh hnehtu i nih theih nân
Lalpa chu i phaw leh i khandaih a ni.
I hmêlmaten khawngaih an dîl ang che;
Nangin i lo rapbet ang.”

en: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin;
mz: Tez-pata kg. ruk, Inbiakna bûka hman lai bûklunga bûk vek la khâwm la, oliv hriak litar li nên chawhpawlh ang che.

en: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest:--
mz: An zîngah chuan keini pawh kan tel vek a, kan tisa châkzâwng ûmin kan tisa duhzâwng leh ngaihtuahzâwng kan ti ṭhîn a, mi dangte ang bawkin Pathian thinurna tuar tûr rênga piang kan nih kha.

en: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
mz: Tin, chu mi ni chuan Davida chuan LALPA chu ahlau va; “Engtin nge LALPA bâwm chu k a hnên a lo thlen theih tak ang?” a ti a.

en: as for thee, O king, thy thoughts came [into thy mind] upon thy bed, what should come to pass hereafter; and he that revealeth secrets hath made known to thee what shall come to pass.
mz: “Khuma i mut laiin lal chuan thil lo thleng tûrte i ngaihtuah a. Thu ril tifiah tûrin Pathian chuan thil lo thleng tûr chu a entîr che a ni.

en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
mz: Tin, LALPAN Mosia thu a pêk angin Midia ho an do va; mipa zawng zawng an that vek a.

en: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
mz: Sukot leh Zereda inkâr, Jordan lui phaizâwl bellei khurah chûng chu lal chuan themthiamho chu a chhûntîr a ni.

en: (1 Corinthians 7:39) Since marriage is a sacred arrangement, divorce is not to be taken lightly.
mz: (1 Korinth 7:39) Inneihna chu Pathian ruahmanna thianghlim tak a nih avângin, inṭhenna chu holam taka ngaih tûr a ni lo.

en: (Psalm 27:14) With hope in Jehovah deeply rooted in our heart, may we be resolved not to give up in doing what is fine .
mz: (Sâm 27:14) Jehova beiseina nei tlatin, thil ṭha tih bânsan loh chu i tum tlat ang u.

en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and him they wounded in the head, and handled shamefully.
mz: Bawih dang an hnênah a tîr leh a, ani pawh chu a lu an vuak pawhsak a, zahthlâk takin an sawisa a.

en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
mz: Mipa takin i puan veng la, Thu ka zawt ang chia, mi hrilh ang che.

en: (Acts 4:31) Furthermore, as we overcome personal fears with Jehovah’s help, we fortify our faith and our trust in his saving arm.
mz: 4:31) Chu bâkah, Pathian Jehova ṭanpuinaa mi mal hlauhna kan hneh hian a chhandamna bân chak tak kan rinna leh kan rinchhanna chu kan thuam nghet sauh va.

en: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
mz: Dân chu thlarau lam thil a ni tih kan hria; kei erawh chu mihring mai, sual bawiha hralh tawh ka ni.

en: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for Jehovah hath sent me as far as Beth-el. And Elisha said, As Jehovah liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth-el.
mz: “Hetah hian lo awm teh, Lalpa chuan Bethel-a kal tûrin min tîr e,” Elija chuan a ti a. Elisa erawh chuan, “Pathian nung leh i nunna chhâlin ka sawi e, ka awmsan tawp lo vang che,” a ti a. Bethel-ah chuan an kal dûn ta a.

en: In Isaiah 39 we are told that when the news of Hezekiah’s sickness and recovery reached the Babylonian court, messengers were dispatched with letters and a present for Hezekiah. Hezekiah had been a recipient of the grace of God, but he was unable to stand the test of grace. God’s Word says, “And Hezekiah was glad for them and showed them his treasury, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the precious oil, and his whole armory and everything which was found among his treasures” (v. 2). Hezekiah could not overcome the temptation to display everything. He had just been wonderfully healed of his sickness and no doubt felt self-important and thought there were few people in the world who had had such a remarkable experience as he. After all, how many had been
mz: Isaia 39 chuan, Hezekia damloh thu leh a ṭhatchhuah leh thu Babulon lal in a lo hriat chuan, Hezekia tân lawmpuina thu leh thilpêk an rawn thawn thu min hrilh a ni. Hezekia chu Pathian khawngaihna changtu a ni a, mahse khawngaihna fiahna chu a ding tlang zo lo a ni. Pathian Thu chuan tihian a sawi a, “ Hezekia chu an chungah a lawm a, an hnenah a thilhlu dahna in te, tangka te, rangkachak te, englo rimtui te, hriak hlu tak te, a ralthuam dahna inchhûng zawng zawngte, rohlu awm zawng zawng chu a entir a” (ch. 2). Hezekia chuan thil engkim phochhuah duhna thlemna chu a do zo lo a ni. A natna aṭanga ropui tak a tihdam hlim chauh a ni a, mahni indah pawimawhna leh a neih ang tawnhriatna hriatreng tlak nei khawvelah mi tlemte chauh awm tura hriatna a nei ngei ang. Chubakah, mi engzatin nge tihdam anih laia chhinchhiahna ropui tak, Ahaza dar tehna hlim rahka sawm a tih kir tir (Isa. 38:8) ang chu nei ve ang?

en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this vial of oil in thy hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead.
mz: Chûng lai chuan zâwlnei Elisan zâwlnei la tlangvâl tak hi a ko va, “Insiam la, he hriak bûr hi keng la, Ramot-gilead-ah va kal rawh.

en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
mz: Chutichuan lal chu Gilgal-ah a kai a, Chimhama chu a hnênah chan a kai ve a: tin, Juda mi zawng zawng chuan lal chu an hruai kai a, Israel mi paw a chanve an tel a.

en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
mz: Tin, Juda lal Zedekia hnênah hêng thu zawng zawng ang zêl hian ka sawi a: Babulon lal nghâwngkawl bat ula, amah leh a mite rawngbâwl ula, in nung dawn nia.

en: Return to thy house, and declare how great things God hath done for thee. And he went his way, publishing throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done for him.
mz: Nimahsela, Isuan, “I in lamah haw la, Pathianin thil a tihsak che hi va hril zâwk tawh,” tiin a kirtîr ta a. Tichuan, a kal a, khawpui chhûng zawng zawngah chuan Isuan thil a tihsak chu a va tlângaupui ta a.

en: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice: and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.
mz: He berâm huanga mi lo hi berâm dang ka nei; anni pawh ka la rawn hruai ngei dâwn. Ka aw pawh an ngaithla ang a, vêngtu pakhat neiin berâm rual khat an ni tawh ang.

en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
mz: Ahazia chu an zawng a, an man a, (Samari-ah a biru a ni) Jehua hnênah an rawn hruai a, an that a; tin, “A thinlung zawng zawnga LALPA zawng thin Jehosaphata fapa a ni si a,” an ti a, a phûmin an phûm a. Tichuan Ahazia chhûngte chuan an ramah thuneihna an nei ta lo va.

en: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
mz:
Dik taka ka tih ṭhin avângin Lalpan lâwmman min pe a,
Pawi ka khawih lo tih a hria.

en: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon.
mz: Jerusalem lal te, Hebron lal te, Jarmut lal te, Lakis lal te leh Eglon lal te chu pûk ata an rawn hruai chhuak a.

en: and he shall say, I tell you, I know not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
mz: ani erawh chuan, ‘Ka hrilh a che u, khawi lama mi nge in nih ka hre lo a che u; nangni thil sual ti zawng zawngte u, ka hnên ata kal bo vek rawh u,’ a la ti ang che u.

en: (Psalm 72:13) Thus, we are encouraged to do what we can, patiently waiting until circumstances change —either in this system of things or in that which is to come.
mz: (Sâm 72:13) Chuvângin, kan tihtheih apiang ti chung a, hun a inher danglam hun chu dawhthei taka nghâk tûra fuih kan ni —he kalhmangah a inher danglam emaw, hun lo la awm tûrah a inher danglam emaw pawh ni se.

en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, and he himself is judged of no man.
mz: Thlarau mi erawh chuan thil engkim a thliar thiam a; ani lah chu tu man an hrethiam pha si lo.

en: (Matthew 28:16, 17; 1 Corinthians 15:6) There, Jesus gave them a weighty commission: “Go therefore and make disciples of people of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the holy spirit , teaching them to observe all the things I have commanded you.”
mz: (Matthaia 28:16, 17; 1 Korinth 15:6) Chutah chuan, Isua chuan an hnênah hna pawimawh tak chu a pe a ni: “Chutichuan kal ula, hnam tina mi zirtîrahte siam ula, Pa leh Fapa leh thlarau thianghlim hmingah chuan baptis ula, thu ka pêk zawng zawng che u pawm tûrin zirtîr rawh u,” tih chu.

en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
mz: Tin, Philistia mite chu Rephaim ruamah an inzar a.

en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
mz: A fapa a aiawh a puithiam hna thawk tura ruata chuan hmunthianghlima rawngbâwl tura inbiakna puan ina a luh hunah ni sarih chhûng chu inthuamin a awm tur a ni.

en: (Hebrews 10:12, 13) Then, near the end of the first century C.E., the aged apostle John foresaw in a vision the Universal Sovereign, Jehovah, installing Christ Jesus as King of the newborn heavenly Kingdom.
mz: (Hebrai 10: 12, 13) Tichuan, C.E. kum zabi khatna tâwp dâwn hnaihah, tirhkoh upa tawh tak Johana chuan inlârnaah Lei leh Vâna Lalchungnungber Jehova leh vân lam Lalrama Lala siam thar Krista Isua chu a hmu a ni.

en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
mz: Esauva chuan a nupui te chu Kanaan rama nula zînga mi a ni, a neih ni; Hit mi Elona fanu Adai leh,Hiv mi Zibeona tunu, Anaa fanu Oholibâmi te chu an ni;

en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
mz: I khawpui thianghlimte chu thlalêrah a lo chan a, Zion chu thlalêrah a lo chan a, Jerusalem chu hmun tihtiauvah a lo chan tak hi.

en: and the lodges thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
mz: Vênbûk te, veranda te, chhûng lam pindan bang te pawh a dang tiat vek a ni. Tukverh tê te, ban te, hulhliap te a awm vek a, a thui lam pawh tawng sawmnga, a zau lam tawng sawmhnih leh panga bawk a ni.

en: The word that Jehovah spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
mz: Babulon lal Nebukadnezara a lo kal a, Aigupta ram a rawn nghaisak tûr thu zâwlnei Jeremian Lalpa thu a sawi chu:

en: And he said, ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and are gone away, and what have I more? and how then say ye unto me, What aileth thee?
mz: “Eng nge ni ta te in han ti a; ka puithiam min chhuhsak a, pathian, ka siamte chu min rûksak a, eng mah hnutchhiah in nei hlei nêm,” a ti a.

en: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
mz: LALPA vêkin Mosia hnênah, Rimtui tuiber zînga mi-murra tui sekel zanga leh, thakthîng rimtui, chumi zâtve sekel zahnih leh sawmnga zet- leh fu rimtui sekel zahnih leh sawmnga leh,

en: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
mz:
Tichuan, mipui an lo pung khâwm ang a,
Hnam tinrêngin Lalpa rawng an bâwl ang.

en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
mz: LALPA dan chu a tha famkim a, nunna suam tha thin: LALPA thuhriattir chu a rinawm a, mi mawl a tifing thin;

en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
mz: Zion fapa hlu tak, rangkachak tha mi nêna tehkhin theihte chu Hlum bel, bel vawtu kut chhuak ang maia ngaih lah ni ta!

en: Did Paul disclose all his revelations? Far from it. He wrote, “I know a man [who is himself] in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know; God knows) such a one was caught away to the third heaven” (v. 2). He did not divulge this experience until fourteen years later. What depth there was in Paul! It would be a wonder if we could hide away something we received from God for seven years. But for fourteen years Paul never divulged his experience; for fourteen years God’s church knew nothing of it; for fourteen years not one of the apostles had heard of it. Paul’s roots were deep beneath the soil.
mz: Paula chuan a thu hriat zawng zawng chu a puang vek em? A teuh lo mai. Tihian a ziak a “Kristaah mi pakhat (chu chu amah) ka hria a, kum sawm pali kal tawhah (Taksa in nge a awm taksa lo in ka hre lo, Pathian in a hria) vânthumnaah lâk chhohin a awm a.” (ch.2) He a tawnhriatna hi kum sawm pali hma chuan a sawichhuak lo a ni. Paula chu a va thûk em! Pathian aṭanga thil kan dawnte kum sarih chhung kan thuhruk theih chuan thilmak a ni ang. Mahse kum sawm pali chhung chu Paula chuan a thiltawn a sawi chhuak ngai lova; kum sawm pali chhûng Pathian kohhranten chu chu an hre miah lo; kum sawm pali chhûng apostle zinga pakhat pawhin an hre lo a ni. Lei hnuai lama Paula zung kaih chu a thûk êm êm a ni.

en: And his rock shall pass away by reason of terror, and his princes shall be dismayed at the ensign, saith Jehovah, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
mz:
Thlaphâng takin an lal a thi ang a,
Bak lêngin sipai hotute chuan an puanzâr an tlânsan ang.
Lalpa thuchhuak chuan heti hian a ti:
“Zion tlângah a mei a alh reng a,
Jerusalem khuaah a thuk pawh a nung reng e.”

en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
mz: nimahsela he mi avâng ngawt hian ka tungding chia, ka thiltihtheihna entîr tûr che leh khawvêl zawng zawnga ka hming a lo than theih nân.

en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he hath spoken on this wise, I will give you the holy and sure [blessings] of David.
mz:
Tin, a ruang pawh ṭawih lova a kaihthawh tûr thu:
‘Davida hnêna ka thutiam thianghlim,
Thlâwn lo tûr chu ka pe ang che,’
tia a sawi ang khân.

en: So Hanamel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the guard according to the word of Jehovah, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of Jehovah.
mz: Tichuan, Lalpa thu ang chuan ka pami fapa Hananela chu vêngtu hung chhûngah ka hnênah a lo kal a, ‘Benjamin bial chhûnga Anathot khuaa ka lo chu lei ta che, rokhâwm thei i ni a, i chan tûr a ni, i tân lei mai rawh,’ mi rawn ti ta a. Hei hi Lalpa thu kha a ni tih ka hre ta a.

en: Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
mz: Chuvângin, hlau suh u, chawngzawng tam tak aiin in hlu zâwk e.

en: And they offered him wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
mz: Mura pawlh uain an pe a; mahse, a duh lo va.

en: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
mz: Tichuan chutiang chu a ni a, a sabengtung hungah chuan a chuang a, leisekawtah a chhuk laiin, ngai teh, Davida leh a mite chuan an rawn pan a; tichuan an intawk ta a.

en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the wind, [nor] how the bones [do grow] in the womb of her that is with child; even so thou knowest not the work of God who doeth all.
mz:
Thli tlehna tûr i hre lo ang leh
Nu puma nau insiam dân i hre lo ang bawk hian,
Pathianin thil engkim a siam dân i hre pha lo.

en: (For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands diligently, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders;
mz: Farisai-te bâkah Juda-ho zawng zawng pawhin upate thu rochhiah zâwmin kut an sil zet loh chuan eng mah an ei ngai lo.

en: After all, it would be contrary to Jehovah’s loving ways to ‘ take away ,’ or disqualify, a disciple of Christ for failing to accomplish something that was beyond his reach. —Psalm 103:14; Colossians 3:23; 1 John 5:3.
mz: Dik tak chuan, Krista zirtîrin a tih theih piah lam emaw, a tlin tâwk piah lam a tihpuitlin theih loh avânga “paih,” a nih loh leh bân mai chu Jehova hmangaihna nên a inkalh tlat ang. —Sâm 103:14; Kolossa 3:23; 1 Johana 5:3.

en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.
mz:
Mi suaksual ni ila ka chan a va chau dâwn êm!
Mi dik pawh ni ila, ka inchhuang thei chuang lo,
Mualpho takin ka awm a, ka tuar tlawk tlawk a nih hi.

en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
mz: Fak der ka thiam si lo va, Chutilochu, mi Siamtuin mi la bo thuai mai ang.

en: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
mz: Ngai teh u, LALPA kut chu chhandam thei lo tûrin tihtawiin a awm lo va; a beng chu hre thei lo tûrin a ngawng hek lo:

en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
mz: Kawlkil tawpa hla sakte kan hria, “Mi flte hnênah ropuina awm rawh se” tih hla hi. Nimahsela, kei chuan, “Ka cher tawlh tawlh a, ka cher tawlh talwh a, ka chung a pik e! vervek taka titute chuan vervêk takin an ti a;a ni, vervek taka titute chuan vervek tak takin an ti,” ka ti a.

en: and kept back [part] of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
mz: a man chu a nupui hriatpuiin anmahni tân an dah hrang a, a ṭhen chauh rawn kengin tirhkohte hnênah a rawn hlân a.

en: (Philippians 4:6) Second , prayers must be offered in the name of God’s Son, Jesus Christ.
mz: (Philippi 4:6) A pahnihnaah chuan, ṭawngṭaina chu Pathian Fapa, Isua Krista hminga hlan tûr a ni.

en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
mz: Ar awmna lama thle Moab rama innghat Ruam awih tlan pangperte chu,” tia sawi a ni.

en: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
mz: Sal chhuakhote chuan Israelte Pathian hnênah hâlral thilhlan an hlan a, Israel zawng zawng pualah bâwngpa sâwm leh pahnih, berâmpa sawmkua leh paruk, berâm no sawmsarih leh pasarih; sual thawi nân kelpa sâwm leh pahnih: heng zawng zawng hi LALPA hnêna hâlral thilhlan vek a ni.

en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the manslayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
mz: Chu khuaah chuan Israel pungkhâwmin a chungthu an rêl fel hma emaw, puithiam lalber ṭang lai a thih hma emaw a awm tûr a ni; chumi zawhah chuan mi that palhtu chu a lo kalna, an khuaah, ama inah ngei a haw leh thei tawh ang.

en: For by the wine of the wrath of her fornication all the nations are fallen; and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth waxed rich by the power of her wantonness.
mz: A uirena, thinurna uain chu Jentail-ten an in a, leia lalte chuan ani chu an tawmpui a, a nawmsak bâwlna chu leia sumdâwngtuten an hausak phah ṭhîn,” tiin a au va.

en: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before Jehovah.
mz: Mite chu Sodom khuaa kal tûrin an chhuk ta a. Abrahama erawh chu Lalpa bulah a ding khawtlai a.

en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
mz: “Thing zawng zawng chu hmupa hnênah an kal a, ‘Nang hi zawng kan lalah i ṭang ngei tûr a ni,’ an ti a.

en: All these were the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
mz: hêng bâkah hian a hmeiho lakah fapa a nei nual bawk. Fanu Tamari pawh a nei bawk.

en: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.
mz: Chûng thil hnuah chuan Aigupta lal no kengtu leh chhang siamtu chuan an pu Aigupta lal hmaah thil tih fel loh an nei a.

en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
mz: Tin, Mitka atang chuan an chhuak a, Hasmona-ah awmhmun an khuar a.

en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
mz:
Lalpa, vânten i thil mak tih an aupui a,
Mi thianghlimte pung khâwm zîngah i rinawmzia an fak.

en: And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah; and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither decide after the hearing of his ears;
mz:
Lalpa ṭih hi a lawmzâwng tak a ni ang a,
A lan dân ang maiin ro a rêl lo vang a,
Benga a hriat satliah aṭang maiin thu a pawtchat hek lo vang.

en: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
mz: Chuvangin LALPA, Sipaihote Pathian chuan heti hian a ti: Chutiang thu chu in sawi avângin, ngai rawh, I kâa ka thute chu meiah ka chantir ang a, Heng mipuite hi thingah, tin, a kang zo vang.

en: The trees of Jehovah are filled [with moisture], The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
mz:
Lalpan a phun Lebanon tlâng sidar thing chuan
A duhtâwk tui a hmu.

en: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
mz: “Mihring fapa, Israel rama hmun ram tawh hnua awmte chuan, ‘Abrahama chu pakhat a ni a, ram chu a luah a, keini erawh chu tam tak kan ni a; ram chu rochun tûra pêk a ni tawh ang chu,’ tiin a sawi a.

en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my lord:
mz: Lota chuan, “Ni lo ve, ka pu,

en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
mz:
I hming ngainatute rinchhan i ni a,
Lalpa, nangmah zawngtute chu
I thlahthlam ngai si lo.

en: They shall perish; but thou continuest: And they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
mz:
Chûngte chu an la boral ang a,
Nang erawh chu i awm reng ang.
Chûng zawng zawngte chu silhfên angin an la hlui ang a,

en: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of Jehovah; for ye have had compassion on me.
mz: Saula chuan, “Mi in ṭanpui ṭhin avângin Lalpa chuan mal sâwm che u rawh se.

en: And Jehovah uttereth his voice before his army; for his camp is very great; for he is strong that executeth his word; for the day of Jehovah is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
mz:
Lalpa chuan a sipai rual thu a pe a,
A hote chu chhiar sên rual an ni lo.
A thu zâwmtute chu thiltithei tak an ni,
Lalpa ni chu a ropui a, hlauhawm tak a ni,
Tu nge dâwl zo vang?

en: that saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers;
mz:
Tuifinriat chu kang chat tûrin thu ka pe a,
A tuite chu a kang ta a.

en: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
mz: I chachhuah dâwn lâwm ni? Mihring fapa, chachhuah ta che. An pate tenawmnate chu hriattîr rawh;

en: (2 Corinthians 4:4) He is the most selfish and cruel person in the universe.
mz: (2 Korinth 4:4) Ani chu lei leh vâna mahni hmasial ber leh nunrâwng ber a ni a.

en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
mz: Tin, Jesaia chuan Sama a va kaltir leh a. Tin, ani chuan, “Hei pawh hi LALPA thlan a la ni lo cheu,” a ti a.

en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, Because I saw my help in the gate:
mz:
Rorêlnaah ṭantu ka neih dâwn avânga,
Fahrahte chunga kut ka thlâk chuan,

en: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
mz: Tin, kum rukna, thla rukna, chumi thla ni nga nîah chuan heti hi a ni a, ka inah ka ?huta, Juda upate ka hmaa an ?hut lai chuan Lalpa Pathian kut chu ka chungah a lo awm a.

en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
mz: Chu! I ral vengtute aw chu! Aw an chhuah a, hlim takin an zaiho chu: LALPA chu Zion-a a lo kir leh hunah chuan inhmatawnin an hmu dan si a.

en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
mz:
Hmun Thianghlim aṭanga ṭanpui chein,
Zion aṭang chuan pui che rawh se.

en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
mz: Chutichuan Jehoraman a pa ram a han luah chuan a lo intichak ta a, a unaute zawng zawng chu Israelte zinga puipa tam takte nen khandaihin a tihlum vek a.

en: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the children of men, He set the bounds of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.
mz:
Chungnungberan hnamte ram a sem a,
Mite awmna tûr a ruatsak lai khân,
Pathian fate zâtin
an ramri a khamsak a.

en: (Ecclesiastes 3:4) Jesus also drew close to Jehovah by studying the Scriptures.
mz: (Thuhriltu 3:4) Isua chuan Pathian Thu zirna hmangin Jehova a hnaih bawk a.

en: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers-in-wait was, that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.
mz: Israel sipai bupui leh biruho khân rem an insiam a, khua aṭangin mei khu luih luih an hmuh chuan,

en: Binding his foal unto the vine, And his ass's colt unto the choice vine; He hath washed his garments in wine, And his vesture in the blood of grapes:
mz:
Grep hruiah sabengtungno a thlung a,
A no ṭha chi chu grep rah tui ber kûngah.
A kawr uain-ah a chiah a,
grep tui senin a puan a su.

en: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
mz: Kei in hnêna lo kal leh lo tûr ang hrimin ṭhenkhat chu in uang hle a ni.

en: And he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
mz: Rorêlna pindan a siam leh a, chutah chuan lalṭhutthlêng a hûng a, chu chu rorêlna hmun a ni. A chhuat aṭanga a chung thlengin sidar thingphelin a thuah vek a.

en: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.
mz:
Ka mikhualte leh ka chhiahhlawh nulaten
Mikhualah min ngai a,
An hmêlhriat loh, ram dang miah min ngai.

en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
mz: Nupui hmu chuan thil tha a hmu a ni, LALPA duhsakna a chang thin.

en: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
mz: Tin, Absaloma chu lal hnêna a kal a, “Ngai teh, i chhiahhlawhin berâm hmuh a mehtir a; lal leh a chhiahlawhte chu i chhiahlawh hnênah hian kal ve ang hmiang,” a ti a.

en: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Assign you the cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by Moses,
mz: “Israel mite hrilh rawh, Mosia ka hrilh ang khân inhumhimna tûr khua ruat rawh u.

en: Woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
mz: Nangni Dânhremite u, in chung a pik e, Finna chabi chu in kawl bo daih a, nangni lah lût duh si lovin, a lût tûrte in khap bawk si,” a ti a.

en: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold, the head of Ish-bosheth, the son of Saul, thine enemy, who sought thy life; and Jehovah hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
mz: Isboseta lu chu Hebron khuaa Davida hnênah an rawn thlen a, lal hnênah chuan, “Hei, i hmêlma, thah tumtu che Saula fapa Isboseta lu kan rawn hâwn e. Ka pu, lal phuba chu, Lalpa chuan vawiin hian Saula leh a thlahte chungah a la ta a ni,” an ti a.

en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
mz: Tin, hung chhûng pâwnta zâwk kawngka in hmâr lampanga mi chu a dung leh a vâng pawh a teh a.

en: For I determined not to know anything among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

mz: Tlâng an pun ang a, lungin an dêng ang chia, ngûnhnâmin an chhun ang che.

en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man's life) to employ them in the siege:
mz: Lak tuma in beih a, khua chu rei tak in hual pawhin chunga thingte chu hreipuiin in kit tur a ni lo va in ei atan a ni a, in kit tur a ni lo: thing chu mihring em an niha in hual ni?

en: And Jehovah God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

en: B ut, brothers and sisters, is this good enough? I think when we meet those who enjoy Christ as their daily manna, we are very happy. We say, “Oh, praise the Lord, here are some brothers and sisters who really enjoy the Lord as their manna day by day!” But we must realize that this falls far short of God’s purpose. God’s purpose is not just that we enjoy Christ a little, but that He should be the all-inclusive One to us. Look at this verse: “As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him” (Col. 2:6). He is a sphere, a realm for us to walk in. He is not just some food or water, but a realm, a land within which we can walk. We must walk in Him. He is our land, He is our earth, He is our kingdom. Walk in Him.

en: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
mz: Tin, a hoten a hnênah, “Ngai teh, Israela chhûngkaw zinga lalte hi mi khawngaih thei tak lal an ni ti thu kan ria a: saiin puan fengin, kan lu-ah hruia inhlingin Israel lal hnênah min va kaltir rawh khai; ani chuan a zuah duh mial mahna che,” an ti a.

en: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the nation, even the men of war that came forth out of Egypt, were consumed, because they hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah: unto whom Jehovah sware that he would not let them see the land which Jehovah sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
mz: Israel mite chu thlalêrah kum sawmli an vâkvai a, Aigupta ram ata an chhuah aṭanga râlkai tawh chin chu an thi hman vek a ni. Lalpa thu an ngaihthlâk loh chuan khawizu leh hnutetuia luang ram pêk a tiam chu an thleng ve lo vang tia a sawi tawh ang khân.

en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

mz: Tin, LALPAN a hnênah, “He ram hi a ni, Abrahama te, Isaaka te, Jakoba te hnena, ‘I thlahte ka la pe ang,’ tia chhechhama ka lo tiam kha; a hmuh zawng ka hmuhtir phawt chia, nimahsela chutah chuan i kal lo vang,” a ti a.

en: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
mz: In thlahtute suahsualna te, Juda lalho suahsualna te, an mipuite suahsualna te, nangmahni ngei suahsualnate leh in nupuite suahsualna, Judai ram leh Jerusalem kawtthlêra an tih takte chu in theihnghilh ta êm ni?
