en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.
mz: Lalṭhutthlênga ṭhu-a ding lamah chuan, pâwn lam leh chhûng lama ziak lehkhabu zial, chhinchhiahna pasariha châr tlat ka hmu a.

en: (James 5:11) We read at Job 42:12: “ As for Jehovah, he blessed the end of Job afterward more than his beginning.”
mz: (Jakoba 5:11) Joba 42: 12-ah heti hian kan chhiar a ni: “LALPA chuan Joba hun hnuhnûng chu a tîr aia nasa takin mal a sâwm a,” tiin.

en: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
mz: Tin, ani chuan, “Tun ang hun a lo thlen leh tikah chuan fapa i pawm tawh ang,” a ti a. Tin, ani chuan, “A, ka pu, nang Pathian mi, i bawihnu lakah hian daw ma ta che,” a ti a.

en: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, [yea], all ye beasts in the forest.
mz:
Ramhnuaia chêng, ngawpuia tla,
Sakawlhte u, lo kal ula, han seh rawh u,

en: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
mz: Lal Jehoiakima leh a mi ropuite zawng zawng leh hotute zawng zawngin an hriatin lal chuan tihhlum a tum a; mahse Urian a hriatin a hlau va, a tlan bo va, Aigupta ramah a kal ta a.

en: Let peoples serve thee, And nations bow down to thee: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be every one that blesseth thee.
mz:
Hnam dangte chuan i rawng bâwl se,
Hnam tinrêngten chibai bûk che rawh se.
I unaute chungah lal la,
I nu fate chu i hmaah kûn rawh se.
nchhe lawhtu che chu ânchhia lawh a ni ang a,
Mal sâwmsaktu che chu duhsak an ni ve ang,” a ti a.

en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
mz: “Ahaba ka hmaa a inngaihtlâwmzia hi i hmu em? Ka hmaa a inngaihtlâwm avâng hian ama chanah hi chuan thil tha lo ka thlentir lo vang a, a fapa chhanah erawh chuan a chhûngte chungah thil tha lo ka thlentir ang,” tiin.

en: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
mz: Tin, an sipaihote zawng zawng nen mi tam tak, an tam lam chu tuifinriat kama tiau vaivut zat zet, akawr leh tawlailir tam tak nen an thawk ta chiam a.

en: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: he hath no standing grain; the blade shall yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.
mz:
Thlifîm a tleh a, thlipuiin a nuai dâwn a ni,
An thlai chîn chu a vui lo vang a, a rah hek lo vang,
Rah mah se, hnam dangte ei tûr mai a ni.

en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
mz: Mi tin, an mawl, hriatna lovin, Rangkachak chhertute an milem chherin a tizak a, A milim chhun chu dawt mai a ni si, Anmahniah thaw pawh a awm lo.

en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
mz: Tin, ngai teh, i hnênah ka awm a, i kalna apiangah ka vêng zêl ang chia, he ramah hian ka hruai kîr leh ang che; i hnêna ka sawi hi ka tih hma loh chuan ka thlahthlam dâwn lo che a ni,” a ti a.

en: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee, or if thou know him not, then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house, and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again.
mz: Tin, in unaute in kiang hnaia awm an nih loh va, a neitu chu in hriat loh emaw ani chuan, in in lamah in hruai haw ang a, in hnenah a awm reng ang a, in unauvin a rawn zawn hun hunah in lo pêk leh tur a ni.

en: (Leviticus 3:1-16; 7:28-36) The Memorial too is a communion meal because it involves a sharing together .
mz: (Leviticus 3: 1- 16; 7: 28-36)* Hriatrengnaah pawh hian eihona a tel avângin, chu chu remna chawhlui a ni.

en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face; for man shall not see me and live.
mz: Ka hmêl erawh chu i hmu thei lo vang; min hmu chu tu mah an nung thei lo a ni,” a ti a.

en: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
mz: Amaherawhchu, mi sual chu a awm dân kalsan tûra i hrilha, a awm dân a kalsan si loh chuan, a khawlohnaah a thi ang a, nang erawh chuan i nun i humhim a ni ang.

en: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
mz: Tin, Solomonan Gezer khua te, Beth-horon thlangta zawk khua te,

en: Wherefore, my brethren beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my beloved.
mz: Chuvângin, ka unau duh tak leh ngaih êm êm, ka lâwmna leh mi chawimawitu duh takte u, chutiang chuan Lalpaah ding nghet rawh u:

en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
mz: Israel mi zawng zawng chu thla sarihna, Ethanim thlaah kût hmang tûrin lal Solomona hnênah chuan an lo kal khâwm a.

en: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
mz: a hnênnah, “Ngai teh, i lo pa ta hle mai a, i fapate lah chuan i dawm dan chu an la ve si lo va; hnam dang zawng zawngte ang bawka kan chunga rorêl tûrin lal min siam rawh khai,” an ti a.

en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
mz: An tha zâwk e khandaiha thi, riltama thi ai zawngin, An râwp ral a, loa thlai tharte tlachhamin.

en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples;
mz: ka mit hian a hmu ta e.

en: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
mz: Tin, kei chuan, “E, Lalpa PATHIAN, ngai teh, thu ka sawi thiam lo, ka naupang si,” ka ti a.

en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
mz: Tin, amah nen, Dana hnama mi Ahisamaka fapa Oholiaba nen mite zirtir theihna finna a pe ve ve a.

en: from the first-born of the children of Israel took he the money, a thousand three hundred and threescore and five [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary:
mz: Israel zînga fa tîr aṭangin tangkarua biakbûk tehna anga sekel sângkhat leh zathum leh sawmruk leh panga a la khâwm a.

en: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
mz: “Hawh u, Lalpa hnênah i kîr ang u; Min lo pawt sawm tawh na a, min tidam leh dâwn si a; Min lo vaw tawh na a, min tuam leh dâwn si a.

en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
mz: Mihring kawngte chu LALPA mithmuhah a awm a, A kawng zawng zawng a tihrualremsak thin.

en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's.
mz:
Hnehtute chu Zion tlângah an chho vang a,
Edom ramah ro an rêl ang.
Ram chu Lalpa ram a ni si a.

en: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.
mz: Zâna a lên erawh chuan a petek ṭhîn, amahah êng a awm loh avângin,” a ti a.

en: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
mz: Hnam, anmahni leh an thlahtute pawhin an hriat ngai lohte zingah ka tidarh ang: ka tihboral vek hma chu khandaih ka umtir ang.

en: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;
mz: “Mi leh sa tiboral tûra hripui ka lêntîra, ka thinurna ka leih buak chuan,

en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
mz: Ka khawlohnate hi mi silfaisak var la, Ka sual hi mi thlenfaisâng ang che.

en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
mz: Thla khatnaa thawk pâwl, mi sînghnih leh sângli chu Zabdiela fapa Jesobeaman a ho va.

en: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
mz: sipaihote LALPA erawh chu rorêlnaa chawisanin a awm ta zâwk a, Pathian, Mi Thianghlim chu, felnaa tihthianghlimin a awm ta a.

en: (Titus 1:2) And he inspired the apostle Paul to write to the Hebrew Christians in the first century: “Keep praying for us, for we trust we have an honest conscience, as we wish to conduct ourselves honestly in all things.” —Hebrews 13:18.
mz: (Tita 1:1-2) Ani chuan tirhkoh Paula chu kum zabi khatnaa Hebrai Kristiante hnênah: “Min ṭawngṭaisak rawh u; engkimah fel [“rinawm,” NW] taka awm tumin, chhia leh ṭha hriatna thiang tak kan nei tih dik takin kan inhre si a,” tia ziak tûrin a thâwk khum a ni.—Hebrai 13:18.

en:
He who loves father or mother above Me is not worthy
of Me; and he who loves son or daughter above Me is
not worthy of me; and he who does not take his cross
and follow after Me is not worthy of Me. He who finds
his soul-life shall lose it, and he who loses his soul-life
for My sake shall find it. ( Matt. 10:37-39 )
mz:
“Tupawh a nu emaw, a pa emaw keimah aia hmangaih zawk chu,
ka mi ni tlâk a ni lo; tupawh a fanu emaw, a fapa emaw keimah aia
hmangaih zâwk pawh ka mi ni tlâk a ni lo. Tupawh a kraws pua mizui
lo chu ka mi ni tlâk a ni lo. Tupawh a nunna hmu chuan a chân ang a;
Keimah avânga nunna chân chuan a hmu ang” (Matt. 10:37-39).

en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
mz: Ani chuan anmahni sualna ngei chu an chungah atlaktir a, Anmahni that lohna ngeiah chuan a tiboral ang a; LALPA kan Pathian chuan a tiboral ang.

en: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;
mz:
Tu mah mahni an intlan thei lo asin:
Pathian hnênah intlanna man an pe thei hek lo.

en: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
mz: Tichuan ani chuan, “vawiinah hian Saphata fapa Elisa hian a lu a la put na chuan pathianin a tih tihin mi ti mai sela, chu aia nasa pawhin,” a ti a.

en: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
mz: A thla ruknaah chuan Galili rama khaw pakhat Nazaret an tiha awm, nula thianghlim pakhat, Davida thlaha mi, Josefa nupui hual hnênah chuan.

en: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
mz: Tin, LALPA chu chhumah chuan a lo chhuk a, tin, a kiangah a va ding a, LALPA hming chu a lam ta a.

en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
mz: Chûng chu puithiamin maichâmah, Lalpa hnênah ei tûr thilhlanah a hâl ral tûr a ni.

en: ( Mark 10:38, 39) The apostle Paul later spoke of Christians’ being “baptized into [Christ’s] death.”
mz: (Marka 10: 38, 39) A hnuah tirhkoh Paula chuan Kristiante chu ‘Krista thihnaa baptis’ an ni tih a sawi a ni.

en: Even the jackals draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: The daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
mz:
Chinghnia pawhin a no hnute a pe ṭhîn a,
Ka mite erawh chu thlalêr vanghâwngsei
Nun râwng tak ang hi an ni ta e.

en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom. And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
mz: Hurama chuan, “LALPA, Israelte Pathian, lei leh vân siamtu, LALPA in leh lal in sa tûra finna leh hriatna nei fapa fing tak lal Davida petu chu fakin awm rawh se. Mi themthiam, finna le hriatna nei, Dana thlaha mi hmeichhe pakhat fa, a hming Hurama ka rawn tir e, a pa chu tûra khuaa mi, rangkachak lam te, tangkaraw lam te, dar lam te, thir lam te, lung lam te, thing lam te, puan senduk te, dumpawl te, puan zai sin te, senlar te deh thiam, ziak eng ang pawh thiam, thiam tinreng thiam a ni a; i mi themthiamho leh ka pu i pa Davida themthiamho zinga chuan a rawn thawk ve ang.

en: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
mz: Abimeleka chuan berâm te, bâwngpa te, bawihpa te, bawihnu te a thlang chhuak a, Abrahama chu a pe a, a nupui Sari pawh a pe kîr a.

en: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
mz:
Mi thiltithei tak chu meibu ang hi a ni,
A thiltih pawh meisi ang hi a ni,
Chu chuan a timût ang a, tu man an timit lo vang.”

en: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
mz: Tin, anni chuan, “Keini i chhiahhlawhte hi unau sâwm leh pahnih, Kanaan rama awm mi pakhat fa kan ni’ tin, ngai teh, kan tlum ber chu tûnah chuan kan pa hnênah a awm a, pakhat chu a awm ta lo a ni,” an ti a.

en: Should not appreciation for this move us to pray regularly to the One who is rightly called the “Hearer of prayer”? — Psalm 65:2.
mz: Chu mi avânga kan lâwmna chuan “ṭawngṭaina Ngaithlatu” tia inâwm taka koh hnêna ṭawngṭai ziah tûrin min chêttîr tûr a ni lâwm ni? —Sâm 65:2.

en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive-trees and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, Jehovah will deliver us.
mz: Lal chuan in ram anga ram ṭhaah, grep huan ṭha tak tak, uain tamna ramah a la awmtîr ang che u a, chhangphut tûr buh ṭhat duhna ram, oliv kûng te, a hriak te, khawizu tamna ramah chuan a awmtîr ang che u. A thu in awih chuan nungdamin in chhuak ang, in thi lo vang. ‘Lalpa chuan min chhan chhuak ngei dâwn e,’ tiin Hezekia chuan bum che u suh se,

en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek Jehovah!
mz:
Ṭanpuina dîl tûra
Aigupta ram pan thla,
Sakawr chakna ringtute tak hi aw!
Sakawr-tawlailîr an ngah a,
An sakawr chungchuangte âwm a khauh avângin an ring a ni.
Israel Mi Thianghlima lam an hawi duh lo va,
Lalpa lah an râwn duh hek lo.

en: Upon this Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou release this man, thou art not Caesar's friend: every one that maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
mz: Chuvâng chuan, Pilatan amah chhuah dân kawng a zawng ta a; nimahsela, Juda-te an au va, “He mi hi i chhuah chuan Kaisara ṭhian i ni lo vang; tu pawh lala insiam chu Kaisara do an ni,” an ti a.

en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud [their] desert.
mz:
Lei chungah hian ro han rêl la,
Chapote chu an phu tâwkin han thungrûl rawh.

en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
mz: Tichuan lal Rehoboama chuan hnathawka rawih luihte hotu Hadorama a tir a; ani chuan Israel-ho zawng zawng chuan lungin an lo deng a, a thi ta a. Tin, lal Rehoboama chu Jerusalem khua a tlan tumin a tawlailirah a chuang ta thuai a.

en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
mz: Tin, puithiam kawra khângah te chuan âwmbela khângte chu hrui dum pawlin an chilh zawm tur a ni, themthiam taka tah puithiam kawr hrênna chu lama awm theih nân leh, âwmbel chu puithiam kawr nên a inhran loh nân.

en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
mz: En che u, heng zawng zawng hi ka mitin a hmu a,Ka bengin a hria a, a hre thiam a ni.

en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
mz: “Tin, ka kumkhaw thuthlung, nangni leh thil nung zawng zawng nêna kan inkâra ka thuthlung chhinchhiahna chu hei hi a ni:

en: And Hezekiah prayed before Jehovah, and said, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, that sittest [above] the cherubim, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
mz: Hezekia chu Lalpa hnênah a ṭawngṭai a, “Aw Lalpa, Israel-te Pathian, Cherub chunga ṭhu, nang chauh hi Pathian chu i ni, ram luah zawng zawng rorêltu i ni a, lei leh vân pawh hi i siam a ni.

en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
mz: A dawt chu Henadada fapa Binuian hmun dang, Azaria in a?anga kulh kawi ?anna, a kil thlengin a siam ?ha a.

en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
mz: Seba lalnu chuan Solomona finzia chu a hria a, a in sak ropuizia te a hmu a;

en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent's food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith Jehovah.
mz:
Chinghnia leh berâmno an tla dûn ang a,
Sakeibaknei pawhin bâwng ang maiin buhpâwl a ei ang a,
Rûlte pawhin chawah vaivut an ring bawk ang.
Ka tlâng thianghlimah chuan
Thil ṭha lo leh intihnat rêng a awm lo vang,” Lalpan a ti.

en: (Isaiah 43:10-12, 15) Anointed Christians have been qualified by Jehovah “ to be ministers of a new covenant.”
mz: (Isaia 43: 10-12, 15) Hriak thih Kristiante chu Jehova’n “thuthlung thar rawngbâwltuahte” a tlintîr a.

en: By faith Noah, being warned [of God] concerning things not seen as yet, moved with godly fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
mz: Nova chuan thil lo thleng tûr chungchânga hrilhlâwkna a dawn chu a ngai pawimawh êm êm a, rinnain an chhûngkaw him nân lawng a tu a. Chu chuan khawvêl thiam loh a chantîr a, rinna avânga thiam chantîr a lo ni ta.

en: It is comforting to know that when a person repents, stops doing wrong , and confesses his sins, Jehovah “will forgive in a large way.” —Isaiah 55:7.
mz: Mi a inlam lêt a, a thilsual tih a bânsan a, a sual a puan chuan, Jehova’n “a ngaidam nasa khawp dâwn” tih hriat chu a thlamuanthlâk hle. —Isaia 55:7.

en: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
mz: I laizâwn Sodom khawlohna chu hêng hi a ni: chapona te, ei puar lutuk te, amah leh a fanute nuamtâwlna mai mai te a ni a, mi retheite leh tlachhamte chu a pui chuang hek lo.

en: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before Jehovah.
mz: maichâm ang thing dawhkân, tawng thuma sâng, tawng hniha zau, tawng hniha sei a awm a; a bang te, a chung te leh a kil ban killi te chu thing vek a ni.

en: But he put not their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Jehovah commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.
mz: An fate erawh chu a khawih lo, Mosia Dân bu-a Lalpa thu, ‘Nu leh pate chu an fate sualna avânga tihhlum tûr an ni lo; fate pawh an pate sualna avânga tihhlum tûr an ni lo; anmahni sualna avâng chauhvin mi tihhlum tûr an ni,’ tih kha a zâwm a ni.

en: For he that is not against us is for us.
mz: Min dodâl lo chu kan lamṭang an ni ngai e.

en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
mz: Isuan uain thûr chu a lo in zawh chuan, “A kim ta!” a ti a; tin, a lu a kûn a, a hnuk a chat ta a.

en: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival [to her], to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.
mz: I nupui dam chhûngin a laizâwn nupuiah nei suh.

en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
mz: Chutichuan Gildeona chuan a chhiahhlawhte zinga mi sawm a hruai a. LALPAN a hnêna a sawi ang chuan a ti ta a; tin, heti hi ani a, a pa vangin, chhunah a ti ngam lo va, zanah a ti a ni.

en: (Mark 1:23-28; 5:2-8, 15) If some people become angry and shout at us when we are engaging in the ministry, we similarly need to exercise restraint, and we should endeavor to handle such a situation in a kind and tactful manner . —Colossians 4:6.
mz: (Marka 1: 23-28; 5: 2-8, 15) Rawngbâwlnaa kan tel laia mi ṭhenkhatin thinrim taka min ân khum hian, keini pawh kan dawhtheih a ngai a, chutiang dinhmun chu ngilnei tak leh remhre taka chinfel kan tum tlat tûr a ni. —Kolossa 4:6.

en:
A. As the Indwelling Spirit
God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). This is the special blessing given by God in the New Testament era; it did not exist in the Old Testament. In the OldTestament,GodonlycausedHisSpirittocomefromwith- out to work upon man; He did not cause His Spirit to dwell withinman. Only after the Lord’s death and resurrection did God give His Spirit to us and cause His Spirit to dwell in us as the indwelling Spirit (John 14:16-17). Thus, He is able to reveal both God and Christ to us from within,that we in Christ may receive and enjoy the fullness of God (Col. 2:9-10).
mz:
A. Chhûnglama Chenchilhtu Thlarau Angin
Pathianin kan chhûngah a thlarau a dah a, tichuan a thlarau chu kan chhûngah chenchilhtu Thlarau a ni ang a, Pathian hriatna leh Pathian lama Krista-in kan tâna a hlenchhuah zawng zawng tawnhriatna kan nei thei dawn a ni (Rom 8:9-11). Hei hi Thuthlung Thar huna malsawmna danglam bik Pathianin a pêk chu a ni a; Thuthlung Hluiah a awm rêng rêng lo a ni. Thuthlung Hluiah chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu pawnlama mihring chunga hnathawk tur ringawtin a siam a, mihring chhûngah chuan a Thlarau chu chenchilh turin a siam lo a ni. Lalpa thihna leh thawhlehna hnuah chauh chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu kan hnenah min pe in, chenchilhtu Thlarau angin Thlarau chu kan chhûnga nung turin a siam a (John. 14:16-17). Hei vâng hian kan chhûnglam aṭangin Pathian leh Krista chu a puangchhuak thei a, tichuan Pathian khahna chu keini Krista ami ten kan lo dawn a kan chen theihna turin a ni (Kol. 2:9-10).

en: In the Scriptures, only 1 John 2:27 speaks of the “teach- ing of the anointing.” We all know that anointing is a verbal noun which refers to the activity of the ointment, the mov- ing and the working of the ointment.According to the type of the Old Testament and the fulfillment of the New Testa- ment, ointment or oil in the Scripture refers to the Holy Spirit(Isa.61:1;Luke4:18).Sinceointmentoroilreferstothe Holy Spirit, the “anointing” must refer to the working of the Holy Spirit. The working of the Holy Spirit in us is like the anointing of the ointment; therefore, the Scripture calls this working of the Holy Spirit the “anointing.”
mz: Pathian Lehkhathu ah chuan, 1 Johana 2:27 chiahin “hriakthih zirtirna” a sawi a. Hriakthihna chu thiltih ṭawngkaa sawina, hriak hnawihna thiltih, chêtna leh hriak hnawihna hnathawh tarlangtu chu a ni a. Thuthlung Hlui entirna leh Thuthlung Thar hlenchhuahna behchhanin, Pathian Lehkhathua chawhpawlh hriak emaw, hriak chuan Thlarau Thianghlim chu a kawk a ni (Isaia 61:1; Luka 4:18). Chawhpawlh hriak emaw hriak chuan Thlarau Thianghlim chu a kawh avângin “hriakthihna” chuan Thlarau Thianghlim hnathawh chu a kawk ngei ang. Kan chhûnga Thlarau Thianghlim hnathawh hi chawhpawlh hriak thihna ang chu a ni a; chuvângin Pathian Lehkhathu chuan Thlarau Thianghlim hnathawh chu “hriakthihna” tiin a ko a ni.

en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

en: (Hebrews 11:31; Joshua 2:18-21) There is no doubt that Rahab’s works of faith brought joy to Jehovah’s heart, for he inspired the Christian disciple James to place her name alongside that of Abraham, God’s friend, as an example for Christians to imitate.
mz: (Hebrai 11:31; Josua 2: 18-21) Rinna avânga Rahabi thiltih chuan Jehova thinlung a tilâwm a ni tih a chiang hle, Kristiante tâna entawn tûrte zîngah Pathian ṭhian, Abrahama ruala a hming ziak tel tûra Kristian zirtîr Jakoba chu thlarauva a thâwk khum avângin.

mz:
1 Korinth 5:7 ah
Krista chu kan Kalhlen Kût a nih thu min hrilh.

en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Jehovah overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
mz: Mosia chuan tuipui chungah a bân a phar a, ni a lo chhuah chuan tui chu a insuih zawm leh ta pûng a, Aigupta mite chuan tlânchhiat an tum a; mahse, Lalpa chuan anni chu tuiah chuan a paih lût a.

en: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.
mz: A fate chuan an pa chu an chhûn lo va, dik lo takin ro an rêl a.

en: This meant that her son would be dedicated and set apart for Jehovah’s service . —Numbers 6:2, 5, 8.
mz: Chu mi awmzia chu a fapa chu a inpumpêk ang a, Jehova rawngbâwl tûra tihhranin a awm ang tihna a ni.—Numbers 6:2, 5, 8.

en: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
mz: Hei hi a ni, anmahni hriak thih nia Israela thlahten an pêk tura LALPAN thu a pêk, puithiam hna thawka LALPA rawngbawl tura a hlan ni achina LALPA tana meia thilhlan ata Arona chanvo leh a fapate chanvo tur chu. Hei hi kumkhuaa an thlahte zel thlenga an tih dan tur a ni.

en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
mz: Mahse Joaba leh Abisaia chuan Abnera chu an ûm zel a; tin, Gibeon thlaler kawnga Gia dep Ama tlâng an thlen dawn chuan ni a tla a.

en: His archers compass me round about; He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.
mz:
A thal kâptuten mi hual tlat a,
Dîm lêk lovin ka kalah min kâp a,
Ka mît chu leiah an leihbaw ta.

en: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
mz: Mi zawng zawng hnênah Abimeleka chuan, “Tu pawh, he mi hi emaw, a nupui hi emaw khawih tawh phawt chu tihhlum an ni ang,” a ti bawk a.

en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
mz: Ni hnuaia thil pawi tak ka hmuh chu, mahni tana sum khawl a,

en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye will destroy all this people.
mz: Ani chu tûnah in zui duh lo tak tak a nih chuan thlalêrah min hnutchhiah leh ang a, nangni hian Israel mite hi in tihlum vek dâwn a nih hi,” a ti a.

en: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
mz:
In chungchâng thu ka sawi lâwk a,
A lo thlen hma ngeiin ka hriattîr ṭhîn che u,
Chutilo zawng, ‘Kan milem tih a ni,
Kan chher leh chhûn milemte thu thu-a lo awm a ni,’
In ti vei dah ang e.

en: for we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king's damage.
mz: Tihhluma tihboral vek tûrin kei leh ka mite chu tih kan ni tawh. A hmei a pain bawihah min hralh ni lek sela chu ka ngawi thei ang a, ka tibuai lo vang che; tûnah zawng, kan hmêlmate hian min that chimit vek dâwn a ni,” a ti a.

en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth-gilead is ours, and we are still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
mz: Israel lal chuan a upate hnênah, “Gilead rama Ramot khua hi kan ta a ni reng si a, engtizia nge Suria lal hnên ata kan lâk lêt loh?” a ti a.

en: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
mz:
Ka rem tih lohvin lalte an thlang a,
Ka hriatpui lohvin hruaitute an ruat bawk a,
An tangkarua leh rangkachaka siam milemte chu
An chhiat phah dâwn a ni.

en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
mz: Lalnu Vasti pawhin lal Ahasuera in pakhatah a hrangin nuho tân ruai a ṭheh ve bawk a.

en: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
mz: Kêl hmêl pu ramhuai an be tawh tûr a ni lo; chutiang bia chu Lalpa lakah an uire a ni. He dân hi Israel miten an zâwm kumkhua tûr a ni.

en: Blessed be Jehovah thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because Jehovah loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do justice and righteousness.
mz: I Pathian, Lalpa chu fakin awm rawh se. Ani chu i chungah a lâwm a, Israel-te lalah a siam che a nih hi. I Pathian chuan Israel-te a hmangaih a, dik taka an chunga rorêltu atân lalah a duh che a nih hi,” a ti a.

en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
mz: Mi rethei remruat chu in mualphosak thin, LALPA chu a inhumhimna a nih avângin.

en: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
mz: Ngai rawh, hnamte zingah ka tite ta si chia, Mihringe hmuhsitin.

en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
mz: tin, puithiamin sidar thing leh husop leh lazai sen ala ang a, bawng la an halah chuan a paih lut tur a ni.

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
mz: Chuvângin, Lalpa Pathian chuan hetiang hian a ti: ‘Ramhnuai thing zînga grêp hruite, Fawhkai atân meiah ka tuah mai ang chuan, Jerusalem luahtute chu ka siam ang;

en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings unto Jehovah, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink-offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
mz: A tûkah chuan ran an talh a, Lalpa hnênah thilhlan an hlân a, mipui pawh an eitîr a. Bâwngpa sâng, berâmchal sâng, berâmno sâng an talh a, maichâma hâlral thilhlan pawh an rawn hlân a. Uain thilhlan pawh an rawn hlân a.

en: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
mz:
Lalpan mi felte chu a fiah ṭhîn a,
Mi suaksualte leh nunrâwngte erawh chu a hua.

en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
mz: Tin, Assuria lalin Babulon khuaa mie, Kutha khua amite, Ava khuaa mi e, Hamath khuaa mi e, Sepharvaim khuaa mite a chah chhuak Samari ram khuahte chuan Israela thlahte hmun a luahtir a; tichuan Samari ram chu an lua a, a khuaahte chuan an awm ta a.

en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
mz: Nile lui kianga, Nile lui kam ngeia, ran tlatna phulte leh, Nile lui kianga thil chin zawng zawngte chu a lo ro vang a, len bovin a awm ang a, a awm tawh lo vang.

en: (Luke 6:35) For example, Jehovah “makes his sun rise on both the wicked and the good and makes it rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.”
mz: (Luka 6:35) Entîr nân, ani chuan “mi sualte leh mi ṭhate chungah chuan a nî a chhuahtîr ṭhîn a, mi felte leh mi fel lote chungah pawh ruah a sûrtîr ṭhîn a ni.”

en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
mz: Chutihchuan Hamana chu chu mi ni chuan hlim tak leh lawm takin a chhuak ta a; nimahsela Hamana chuan lal kawt hung kawngkaa Mordekaia chu a hmaa lo ding leh che chang lo a han hmuh chuan, Mordekaia chungah chuan a thinur ta êm êm mai a;

en: And he made the table of acacia wood: two cubits [was] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
mz: Sitim thing dawhkân, a dung tawng hnih, a vâng tawng khat, tawng khat leh a chanvea sâng a siam bawk a.

en: and thou shalt come up against my people Israel, as a cloud to cover the land: it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring thee against my land, that the nations may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
mz: Chhûmin ram a tuam angin ka mi Israel-te chu i tuam ang a, a hun ka tihah chuan. Aw Goga, ka ram chu ka rûntîr ang che, hnam tinin tu nge ka nih an hmuha ka thianghlimzia a lan theih nân.

en: And the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
mz: Thlarauvin Filipa hnênah, “Tawlailîr saw pan la, va pawh rawh,” a ti a.

en: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
mz: Mipui hotute: Parosa te, Pahath-moaba te, Elama te, Zatua te, Bania te;

en: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
mz: Josua hnênah, “I chhiahhlawh kan nih hi,” an ti a. Josua chuan, “Tute nge in nih? Khawi lam aṭanga lo kal nge in nih?” a ti a.

en: BHP THUVAWN "But a woman that feareth the LORD shall be praised" (Proverbs 31:30) BHP MEMBERSHIP BMCF members 18 years of age and older can become BHP members
mz: BHP THUVAWN "Lalpa ṭihtu hmeichhia erawh chuan fak a hlawh ang" (Thufingte 31:30) BHP MEMBER NIH DN BMCF member hmeichhia kum 18 chin chunglam a duh apiang BHP member an ni thei ang

en: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly; thou hast not kept the commandment of Jehovah thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would Jehovah have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
mz: Samuela chuan, “I thil tih dân hi a âtthlâk hle a ni. Lalpa, i Pathianin dân a pêk che hi i zâwm lo va, zâwm la chu Lalpan Israel-te chungah kumkhuain a laltîr tûr che a ni a le.

en: and behold, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth, and it hardly departeth from him, bruising him sorely.
mz: thlarauvin a man fo mai a, a khawih ṭê tuar tuar ṭhîn a, chilphuan tla bawrh bawrhin a sawisa a, thi ang dêrin a kalsan ṭhîn.

en: (Psalm 42:5, 11; 43:5) This recurring verse connects the three stanzas of Psalms 42 and 43 into one poem .
mz: (Sâm 42: 5, 11; 43:5) He châng lang nawn ṭhîn hian Sâm 42 leh 43-naa hla châng pathumte chu hla pakhatah a thlunzawm a.

en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
mz: “Kan koh apianga LALPA kan Pathianin min hnaih anga anmahni hnaih thin Pathian nei hnam ropui tunge awm ve?

en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
mz: Kittim lawngte chuan amah an rawn do dâwn a ni; chutichuan, a lungni lo vang a, a kîr ang a, thuthlung thianghlim chungah chuan a thinur ang a, chutiangin a ti ang; a ni, a kîr leh ang a, thuthlung thianghlim hawisantute chu a lâwm ang.

en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
mz: Eng vangin nge i hmai i thup a, Kan hreawmzia leh hnechhiah kan tuarzia hi i theihnghilh thin ni?

en: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
mz: Tlâng lamah chuan an kal a, ni thum an biru a. Ûmtute chuan an rawn zawng haw zêl a; mahse, an hmu lo.

en: Is his lovingkindness clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?
mz:
Mi khawngaih tawh lovin,
A thutiam kha a titâwp hlen dâwn em ni?

en: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
mz: Tin, Arauna chuan Davida hnênah, “LALPA ka pu chuan awm a tih la sela hlan ang hmiang: en teh, hâlral thil hlan atân bâwngpate chu a awm a, tin, thing atân hrui hmanruate leh sebâwng thuamnate chu a awm a.

en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
mz: Aigupta ram ata i tlan chuaha i mite hmaa hnamdange titlâwm a, thil ropui tak leh hlauhawm ak tia hming ropui ak siamsak tûr chea Pathianin ama mite atâna a rawn tlan chhuah i mi Israel ang rêng rêng hi khawvela hnam dang tunge awm?

en: And every created thing which is in the heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things are in them, heard I saying, Unto him that sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb, [be] the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion, for ever and ever.
mz:
Thil nung tinrêng, vâna mi te, leia mi te, lei hnuaia mi te, tuifinriat leh a chhûnga awm zawng zawng te au thâwm ka hre bawk a,
“Lalṭhutthlênga ṭhu-a leh
Berâmno chuan fakna te, chawimawina te, ropuina te,
Thiltihtheihna te chatuanin nei rawh se,”
an ti a.

en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
mz: Ka tiang dang, ‘Phuarkhâwmna’ chu ka titliak leh a, Juda leh Israel inzawmna chu a chat ta a.

en: The former treatise I made, O Theophilus, concerning all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
mz: Theofil, ka lehkha hmasaah khân Isua rawngbâwl ṭan aṭanga vâna lâk chhoh a nih thlenga a thil tih leh a thu zirtîr zawng zawng chanchin ka ziak tawh a;

en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh (the same is the King's Vale).
mz: Kedorlaomera leh a thurualpui lalte hneha a lo haw chu Sodom lal chuan Save ruamah a lo hmuak a, chu hmun chu ‘lal ruam’ an ti bawk.

en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
mz: Balaama hnênah Pathian a lo kal a, “I mikhualte khu tute nge ni?” a rawn ti a.

en: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, and they that were with him;
mz: Ani erawh chuan an hnênah, “A ṭhiante nên an rilṭâm laia Davida thiltih kha in chhiar lo vem ni?

en: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
mz: Tin, Jeroboama nupui chu a tho va, a chhuak ta a, Tirza khua chu a va thleng a: tin, in kawngka bul a va thlen veleh chuan naupang chu a thi ta a.

en: and those [parts] of the body, which we think to be less honorable, upon these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness;
mz: Kan taksa pêng hmuhsitawm deuhva kan ngaihte hi, chûng ngei chu kan ngai pawimawh a, nasa takin kan chei ṭhîn a, a lang mawi lote chu kan cheimawi zâwk ṭhîn a ni.

en: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city, at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict manner of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as ye all are this day:
mz: “Juda mi, Kilikia rama Tarsa khuaa piang ka ni; nimahsela, he khawpuia sei lian hi ka ni. Gamaliela hnênah min thlahtute Dân khermei taka zawm ka zir a, vawiina nangniho ang bawk hian Pathian tân ṭhahnem ka ngai ṭhîn a.

en: First, we can confess our sins (1 John 1:7, 9).
mz: A hmasa berin kan sualte kan puang thei a (1 John 1:7,9).

en: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Jehovah will reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth even for ever.
mz:
Kebaite chu hnam tundinna bul atân ka hmang ang a,
Hnawh darhte chu hnam chak takah ka siam ang.
Lalpa chuan Zion tlângah chatuanin ro a rêlsak tawh ang.

en: And Haman recounted unto them the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
mz: A hausakzia te, fapa a ngahzia te, lalin a kaisântîr thu te, lalin milian dang zawng zawng aia a ngaihsânzia te sawiin a ina lêng tûra a sâwm a ṭhiante chu a uankhum a.

en: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death, and he be to be put to death, and thou hang him on a tree:
mz: Tin, miin thihna khawp sual a tih a, tihhlum aniha, thinglera in khai chuan,

en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.
mz: Tûn thleng hian ka hmingin eng mah in la dîl lo; dîl rawh u; tichuan, in hmu ang, in lâwm a kimna tûrin.

en: But Rahab the harlot, and her father's household, and all that she had, did Joshua save alive; and she dwelt in the midst of Israel unto this day, because she hid the messengers, whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
mz: Jeriko enthla tûra Josua mi tirhte a lo hum avângin nawhchizuar Rahabi chu a pa chhûngte nên, a neih zawng zawng nên Josua chuan a zuah a, Israel zîngah tûn thlengin an la tel ta reng a ni.

en: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
mz: Davida hian i hnênah engnge a sawi leh chuan ang? I chhiahhlawh hi i hre vek si, aw Lalpa PATHIAN,

en: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
mz: Lui pakhat a awm a, chu mi pengte chuan Pathian khawpui chu a tilawm thin. Chungnungbera awmna hmun thianghlim chu.

en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
mz: Silhfen chu, tah emaw, phiar emaw, sahmul emaw, la zai sin emaw, savuna siam chi reng reng emaw, phar awmna tawh phawt chu a hal tur a ni; phar nghet tak chi a ni si a, hal ngei tur a ni.

en: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
mz: chu mi fapa chu Mika ni a, chu mi fapa chu Reaia a ni a, chu mi fapa chu Baala a ni,

en: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
mz: Jakoba chhûngte zingah hei hi sawi chhuak ula, Judai ramah puang rawh u.

en: (Isaiah 65:11) In God’s eyes, belief in luck is a form of idolatry and is not compatible with true worship.
mz: (Isaia 65:11) Pathian mitah chuan vânneihna rin chu milem biakna chi khat a ni a, biakna dik nên a inrem lo.

en: And they took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people quiet and secure, and smote them with the edge of the sword; and they burnt the city with fire.
mz: Mika milem siam leh a puithiam chu an hruai a, Lais an va thleng a, ngaihngam taka an awm hle hle chu an bei a, khandaihin an sât hlum a, khua chu an hâl a.

en: That, coupled with faith in what they learned from Peter, provided the basis for them to be baptized “in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the holy spirit .”
mz: Chu an thil hriat tawhsa leh Petera hnên aṭang an zir ṭangkawp chuan “Pa leh Fapa leh thlarau thianghlim hminga” baptisma chan theihna a siam a ni.

en: And they that saw it told them how he that was possessed with demons was made whole.
mz: Chûng thil hmutute chuan ramhuai man lo dam tâk dân chu an lo hrilh bawk a.

en: Now a mediator is not [a mediator] of one; but God is one.
mz: Mi pakhat tân palai awm a ṭûl lo ve, Pathian chu pakhat chauh a ni si.

en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
mz: Tin, chutah chuan an milemte an kalsan a, Davida leh a mite hchuan an la a.

en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
mz: Amaherawhchu a bawl var chu a awmna ngaia a awm a, a tai darh loh chuan khawihli ser mai a ni a; puithiamin a thianghlim tih a puang tur a ni.

en: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
mz:
Mi rilru kawite chuan min hlat ṭhîn a,
Thil sual eng mah ka ti duh lo.

en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
mz: Chutichuan Amor-ho lalte panga Jerusalem khaw lal te, Hebron khaw lal te, Jarmuth khaw lal te, Lakis khaw lal te, Eglon khaw lal te chu an pungkhawm a, an sipaiteho zawng zawng nen an han chho va, Gibeon khaw ep an awm ta mp a, an bei ta a.

en: immediately interpret the meaning of the intuition in the spirit. In this way, we can understand the will of God. Then whatever our mind thinks and considers is on the side of the spirit; it no longer yields to the flesh to be employed by the flesh. Our mind then will no longer be a mind set on the flesh, but a mind set on the spirit. Romans 8:6 calls such a mind the “mind of the spirit.” Since this mind of the spirit is constantly set on the spirit and is mindful of the spirit, it allows the life of God to grow out continuously from our spirit.
mz: Thlaraua hriatthiam nghal maitheihna awmzia chu rang takin a sawifiah nghal thei a ni. Heti zawng hian Pathian duhzawng chu kan hrethiam a ni. Tichuan, kan ngaihtuahnain a ngaihtuah leh a ngaihruat apiang chu thlarau lampangah an awm zel a; tisain a hman ṭangkaina turin tisa tân rah a chhuah tawh lo a ni. Kan ngaihtuahna chu tisa chunga innghat ngaihtuahna ni tawh lovin, thlarau chunga innghat ngaihtuahna a ni tawh zâwk ang. Rom 8:6 chuan chutiang ngaihtuahna chu “ngaihtuahna thlarau” tiin a kova. en: and another brother adds a little more weight. Then one day Satan will be cast down from heaven. God does not work directly by His own hand to cause Satan to fall from heaven. It would be very easy for Him to do this work, but He does not. He has entrusted this work to the church. Oh, how piti- fully the church has failed in this matter and been unable to do it! This is why there must be the overcomers standing in the position of the church to do God’s work. When the overcomers stand in the church’s position and do the work which the church should have done, the result will be: “Now has come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ.” The man-child in Reve- lation 12 consists of the overcomers who stand on behalf of the church. Therefore, as soon as the man-child is caught up, Satan is cast down from heaven and the kingdom comes.

en: Then what will be the ultimate issue? Simply this—on the one hand, there will be the New Jerusalem, and on the other, the lake of fire. The New Jerusalem is the Triune God mingled together with the resurrected man, and the lake of fire is Satan’s ultimate destruction. The lake of fire is the place for Satan. All that is not related to the Triune God and the resurrected man will be put into the lake of fire with Satan. There will be only one tree in the New Jerusalem—the tree of life. The other tree will be in the lake of fire. This is the ultimate conclusion of the whole Scripture. The Scriptures began with three parties, but the ultimate consummation will be the New Jerusalem with only the first tree at the center of the city and the resurrected man as the expression of the Triune God. The second tree will be cast into the lake of fire. All things and all people related to the second tree will have the same destiny as Satan—in that lake of fire.

mz: Thil nungte chu thlarau duhna lam lamah an kal a, tawlailîrte pawhin thil nungte tih ang chiahin an ti ve a, thil nungte thlarau chu tawlailîr keahte a awm si a.

en: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
mz: Nang chu serhtan lohte zîngah bung rem rumin i awm ang a, khandaiha thite hnênah i mu ang.

en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
mz: tin, Janoa atang chuan Ataroth-ah te, Naara-ah te a chhuk zel a, Jeriko a tleng a, Jordan-aha chuak a.

en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
mz: Mahse, chumi aiah chuan kulhte pathian chu a chawimawi ang a, pathian, a pate pawhin an hriat ngai loh kha rangkachak nên, tangkarua nên, lunghlute leh thil duhawmte nên a chawimawi ang.

en: for if God spared not the natural branches, neither will he spare thee.
mz: Pathianin zâr takte chu a zuah si loh chuan nang pawh a zuah bîk lo vang che.

en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken thou not, neither consent.
mz: Hruaituho leh mipui chuan, “A thu pawisa suh la, a dîl pawh eng mah pe suh,” an ti a.

en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
mz: halral thilhlan atan bawngpa tuai pakhat, berampa pakhat, beramno a pa kum khat mi pakhat;

en: And Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds,
mz: Saula chuan a kianga ding a ṭhuihruaite hnênah chuan, “Nangni Benjamin mite u, ngaithla rawh u. Jesaia fapa chuan lo te, grep huante pe che uin za hotu-ah te, sâng hotu-ah te a siam vêk dâwn che u em ni?

en: And the apostle Peter counseled fellow Christians to ‘supply to their knowledge self -control.’ —1 Peter 2:21-23; 2 Peter 1:5-8.
mz: Tirhkoh Petera chuan a Kristianpuite chu ‘an hriatnaah chuan insûmna telh’ tûrin a fuih a ni. —1 Petera 2: 21-23; 2 Petera 1: 5-8.

en: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
mz: A zirtîrte chuan, ‘I in tâna ka ṭhahnemngaihna chuan mi ei zo vang,’ tih ziak a nih thu an hre chhuak leh ta a.

en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
mz: Bumna hruihruala khawlohna hnûk a, tawlailir hruizena sualna hnûk chu an chung a pik e!

en: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed to him the way of understanding?
mz:
A bengvâr nân tu nge a râwn ṭhina,
Tu nge kawng dik entîr thei le?
Tu nge hriat tûr zirtîr theia,
Thil tih dân tûr kawhhmuh thei ang?

en: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
mz: Tin, Josua chuan a puante a pawtthler a, LALPA bâwm hmaah amah leh Israel-ho upate chu an hmaia lei sin tlai thlengin an bawkkhup a; tin, an luah vaivut an phul a.

en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
mz: kum sawmhnih achin chung lam Israelte zinga mi ralkai chin zawng zawng chu nang leh Aronan a pâwl pâwlin chhiar vek tur a ni.

en: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
mz: Tin, a in pui sumhmunah chuan mi hruai ta a, sumhmun bangpêngte chu a teh ?heuh va, a lehlam lehlamah tawng ngaa chhah ve ve a awm a, a luhna chu tawng sâwm leh tawng lia zau a ni, a sîr tuaka kawngka bangpêngte chu tawng thum ve ve a ni.

en: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
mz: Tin, Samuela chu a thi ta a; tin, Israel mi zawng zawngte chu an inko khawm a, an tah a. Rama khuaa a inah chuan an phûm ta a. Tin, Davida chu a tho va, Paran thlalerah a chhuk a.

en: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
mz: Beiseina nei mi tângte u, kulhpuiah chuan kîr ula, Vawiin ngeiah hian a leh hnihin Ka pe dâwn che u tih ka puang a ni.

en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
mz: kum sawmthum achin chung lam, kum sawmnga thlengin rawngbawlna hna, inbiakna puan ina thawk tur zawng zawng zat chu chhiar vek rawh u.

en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
mz:
Judai ram leh Jerusalem chungchânga Amoza fapa
Isaian Lalpa thu a dawn chu:

en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
mz: Tupawh a innghahna hnu thil khawih apiangte chu tlai lam thlengin an bawlhhlawh ang; tin, chung thil chawisawntu apiangte chuan an puante an su ang a, an inbual tur ani a, tlai lam thlengin a bawlhlawh ang.

en: For the backsliding of the simple shall slay them, And the careless ease of fools shall destroy them.
mz:
Mi mâwlte chu an lêlohna avângin an thi ang a,
Mi â-te chu an ngaihsam avângin an chhe bawk ang.

en: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all they that had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one that had knowledge, and understanding;
mz: Israel mi, puithiam te, Levia chi te, Tempul pulis te, zaipâwl te, Tempul enkawltu te leh mi dang, keiniho, Pathian Dân zâwm duhtute hian kan vêla awm hnam dangte laka inthiarfihlîma, chinchâng hre pha chin, kan nupui fanaute leh

en: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall destroy them, a leopard shall watch against their cities; every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces; because their transgressions are many, [and] their backslidings are increased.
mz:
Chuvângin, ngawa sakeibakneiin anni chu a seh ang a,
Thlalêr chinghniain a ei zo vang.
Khawpuia mite chu keitein a châng ang a,
A vâkchhuak apiang a lo pawt sawm ang.

en: But the bruising of the serpent in the head would mean that the Devil would receive a death blow from which he would never recover . —Read Acts 2:31, 32; Hebrews 2:14.
mz: Mahse, rûl lû tihthitlinna erawh chuan a din chhuah leh ngai lohna tûra Diabola tihhlumna a kâwk thung a ni. —Tirhkohte 2: 31, 32; Hebrai 2:14 chhiar rawh.

en: (Isaiah 55:11) So, then, what did God originally purpose for mankind, and how will it all work out ?
mz: (Isaia 55:11) A nih leh, mihringte tâna atîra Pathian thiltum chu eng nge ni a, chu chu engtin nge a thlen famkim ang?

en: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
mz: Tin, Lalpa chuan sangha chu a bia a, Jona chu khawmualah a law chhuak ta a.

en: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.
mz: Davida chuan Itaia hnênah, “Chuti chu i kal zêl ang u,” a ti a. Tichuan, Git mi Itaia chu a hote leh an chhûngte nên chuan an kal ve ta a.

en: And know ye this day: for [I speak] not with your children that have not known, and that have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his outstretched arm,
mz: Lalpa chungchâng, nangmahni ngeiin in hriatte kha ngaihtuah ṭhîn rawh u. Chûng thil hretute chu in fate an ni lo, nangmahni ngei hi in ni, Lalpa in Pathian thununna natzia te, a ropuizia te, thu a neihzia te leh thil a tihtheihzia te in hmu a;

en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
mz: Sebâwngpa chuan tun hma pawhin mi sîk lo hmang thîn sela, tin, a neitu chuan khung duh si lo sela, sebâwngpa aiah chuan sebâwngpa vek chu a pe ngei ngei tur a ni a, tin, ran thi ruang chu a hlâwm ang.

en: (Isaiah 14:27) Later, when restored to his senses following a period of insanity, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon humbly acknowledged : “There exists no one that can check [God’s] hand or that can say to him, ‘What have you been doing?’”
mz: (Isaia 14:27) A hnuah, Babulon Lal Nebukadnezzara chuan a âtna ata a rawn harh chhuah leh hun chuan, inngaitlâwm takin: “Tumahin [Pathian] kut chu an chawlhtîr thei lo va, a hnênah, ‘Nangin eng nge i tih?’ pawh an ti thei hek lo,” tiin a pawm a ni.

en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
mz: Juda-ho chuan eng te, lawmna te, hlimna te, chawimawina te an nei a.

en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.
mz: Mosia leh puithiam Eleazara chuan rangkachak chher sate chu Lalpa chuan a mite a hriat reng theih nân Biakbûkah chuan an dah a.

en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
mz: Meraria thlahte chu Jaazia lakah Benoa te, Sohama te, Zakura te, Ibria te an ni.

en: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
mz: Tin, mipuiho zawng zawng, a hnena râl kap mi awmte chu an han kal a, an han hnaih a, khawpui bulah chuan an han kal a, Ai khaw hmar lampangah an han riak a: Ai khua nena an inkârah chuan ruam a awm.

en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
mz: tin, hetiang thil a tih avâng leh khawngaihna a neih loh avângin a berâm no chu a lehliin a rul tûr a ni ang,” a ti a.

en: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
mz: Chung thil chu i ti a, nimahsela ka ngawi reng a; Chutichuan nangmah ang diakah mi ruat thin: Nimahsela ka zilhhau ang chia, i mithmuhah indawt zelin ka tilang ang.

en: These are the families of Manasseh; and they that were numbered of them were fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
mz: Hêngho hi Manasea thlahte chu an ni, mi sîngnga leh sânghnih leh zasarih an ni.

en: Verily I say unto you, All their sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and their blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
mz: Thu dik ka hrilh a che u; miin sualna zawng zawng leh thil pawi tinrêng an sawite chu ngaihdam theih a ni ang.

en: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
mz: Engati nge in hel zual deuh deuh va, vuaka in la awm cheu ni le? Lu chu a pumin a na a, thinlung pawh chu a pumin a chau ta.

en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
mz: “Vawiina ka thupêk che u hi zâwm tlat zêl ang che u; ngai teh u, in hmaah Amor mi te, Kanan mi te, Hit mi te, Periz mi te, Hiv mi te leh Jebus mi te ka ûm chhuak dâwn.

en: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
mz: Tin, ani chuan ka hnênah, “Mihring fapa, an thiltih kha i hmu em? Israel chhûngten thil tenawm nasa tak, heta an tih ngei, ka in thianghlim ata hla taka ka kal bo nân an tih kha? Mahse, thil dang tenawm zaw mah i la hmu leh ang,” a ti a.

en: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
mz: Nimahsela, Pathian tiam, lei thar leh vân thar, a chhûnga dikna awmna chu kan nghâk a ni.

en: There is that scattereth, and increaseth yet more; And there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but [it tendeth] only to want.
mz:
Sem darh chîn chu ngah lehzualna a ni,
Mi kawm tak nih chu tlâkchham ngahna a ni.

en: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.
mz:
An thih pawhin na an tuar lo va,
An thau mûm kûng bawk si.

en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
mz: Tin, lehkha ziaktu Saphana chu lal hnênah a kal a, lal hnênah thu chu a va thlen leh a, “I mite chuan ina tangka awm chu an pe chhuak vek a, lalpa in satu hnathawktute an pe vek ta e,” a ti a.

en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
mz: Tin, chanpual chu Manasea thlahte dang zawng zawng tan an chhûngkaw zir zelin a ni; Abiezera thlahte tan te, Heleka thlahte tan te, Asriela thlahte tan te, Sekema thlahte tan te, Hephera thlahte tan te, Semidia thlahte tan te: chungte chu an chhûngkaw zir zela Josefa fapa Manasea thlah mipate chu an ni.

en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
mz: In thlann pathiante chu au ta che u: anni chuan in mangan hunah chuan chhan chhuak che u ang hmiang,” a ti a.

en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
mz: Kei Paulan keima kut ngeia chibai ka bûkna che u a nih hi. Hetianga ka ziak hi ka lehkhathawn apiang chhinchhiahna a ni.

en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
mz: Tin, Gilea mi Barzilaia chu Rogelam atangin a lo chhuk a; lal chu Jordan-a hruai kai tûrin a hnêna Jordan a ai ve a.

en: Jehovah knew that Joshua had every reason to be afraid , so He told Moses: “Commission Joshua and encourage him and strengthen him, because he is the one who will cross over before this people and he is the one who will cause them to inherit the land that you will see.”
mz: Josua’n hlauhna tûr chhan tam tak a nei ang tih Jehova’n a hriat avângin Mosia hnênah: “Josua hi thu pe la, fuih ṭha la, tichak rawh; hêng mipuite hi a hruai kai dâwn a, i han hmuh tûr ram chu a luahtîr dâwn a ni,” tiin a hrilh a ni.

en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
mz: Aw, i dan hi ka va ngaina êm! Nilenga ka ngaihtuah thin a ni.

en: If he be able to fight with me, and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
mz: Min hneha min tihhlum chuan in chhiahhlawh kan ni ang a, keiin ka ngama ka tihhlum chuan kan chhiahhlawh in ni ang a, kan bawihah in awm ang,” a ti a.

en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
mz: Tunah chuan a thil ker mawi zawng zawngte chu Hreite leh tubohtein an tichhe hlawm a.

en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
mz: Ka thih hnu chuan nasa takin in intichhia ang a, ka thupêk che u kawng ata hi in peng ang tih ka hre reng a ni; tin, a tawpah phei chuan thil tha lovin a tlakbuak ang che u; in kut thiltiha tithinur tura LALPA mithmuha thil tha lo in tih dawn avangin,” tin thu a pe a.

en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
mz: Ani erawh chu Gilgal khaw kianga lung chherna hmun atangin a let leh a, “I e lalpa, thuruk hrilh tûr che ka nei e,” a ti a. Tin, ani chuan,”Ngawi thiap rawh u,” a ti a. Tichuan a bula dingho zawng zawngte chuan an chhuahsan ta vek a.

en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
mz: Isuan an hnênah, “Thu dik ka hrilh a che u, Hun Tharah chuan, mihring Fapa a lalṭhutthlêng ropui taka a ṭhut hunah, nangni mi zuitute pawh hi Israel hnam sâwm leh pahnih chunga rorêlin lalṭhutthlêng sâwm leh pahnihah in la ṭhu ve ang.

en: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
mz: lal vêngtu pâwl hotu Arioka hnênah chuan, “Engtizia nge lal thupêk chu chuti êma a hmanhmawh le?” tiin a chhâng a. Tin, Arioka chuan Daniela chu a hrilh ta a.

en: (Matthew 24:3) They were to be “awaiting and keeping close in mind” the presence of Jehovah’s day.
mz: (Matthaia 24:3) Anni chu Jehova ni lo thlen hun tûr chu “beisei leh ṭhahnemngai taka duhin” an awm tûr a ni.

en: And another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should add it unto the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
mz: Vântirhkoh dang, rangkachak berhbu keng, lalṭhutthlêng hmaa rangkachak maichâmah chuan a lo kal a, mi thianghlimte ṭawngṭaina belhchhah nân rimtui hâl tûr an pe ṭeuh va.

en: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
mz: Tin, ‘I mit hmuh ata paih chhuah ka ni a; Nimahsela, i biak in thianghlim lam ka hawi leh ang,’ ka ti a.

en: and from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
mz: Hesbon leh Ramat-mizpa leh Betonim inkâr ram te, Mahanaim aṭanga Lo-debar ri inkâr te a huam bawk a.

en: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go thou to the sea, and cast a hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a shekel: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
mz: Nimahsela nang, dîlah va kal la, nghakuai chiah la, sangha âwk hmasa ber chu la rawh; a kâ keu la, chêng hnih i hmu ang; chu chu la la, kei leh nanga tân anni chu pe rawh; chutilo chuan, anni chu kan tilungni lo dah ang e,” a ti a.

en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
mz: Ka rilrua ngaihtuah tam tak ka neih lai chuan I thlamuannate chuan ka nunna hi a tihlum thin.

en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
mz: Tin, Reuben-ho leh Gad-ho chu Gilead atanga Arnon ruam, ruam lai tak thlengin an ram chin atan ka pe a; Amona thlahho ramri, Jakob lui thlengin;

en: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
mz: Chutichuan rial, mei leh riala inpâwlh, nasa êm êm mai, Aigupta ram zawng zawngah chuan, Aigupta hnam lo awm a chin, chutiang rêng rêng la awm ngai lo chu a lo awm ta a.

en: And it came to pass in a little while, that the heavens grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel:
mz: Rei lo teah chhûm dum vânah a lo lang tup tup a, thlite a lo tleh ta hum hum a, ruahpuivânâwn a lo sûr ta a; Ahaba chu a tawlailîrah a zuang lût a, Jezreel lamah a tlân haw ta a.

en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
mz: Tin, heti hi a ni ang a, LALPAN in hnênah leh in thlahtute hnêna chhechhama pêk a tiam tawh che u anga, Kanaan-hote rama a hruai thlen che u a, a pêk hun che u chuan,

en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
mz: Lalpa Pathian chuan heti hian a ti a ni: “Hei hi Israel hnam sâwm leh hnam hnih zînga ram in?hen dân tûr chu a ni e. Josefan chan hnih a chang ang.

en: And Jehovah said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee; for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.
mz: Lalpa chuan Samuela hnênah, “Mipuiin i hnêna thil an sawi zawng zawng chu ngaithla teh; nang an duh lo che a ni lo, kei hi an lal atân min duh lo tihna a ni zâwk e.

en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal-zephon: over against it shall ye encamp by the sea.
mz: “Israel fate chu hrilh rawh; kîr leh sela, Migdol leh Tuipui Sen inkârah Pi-hahirot ep Baal-zefon bulah riahhmun khuar rawh se,

en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
mz: “Sealtiela fapa, Judai ram awptu Zerubabela hnênah leh Jehozadaka fapa, puithiam lalber Josua hnênah leh mi la awm chhunte hnênah chuan heti hian sawi ta che:

en: And I will visit upon her the days of the Baalim, unto which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her ear-rings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith Jehovah.
mz:
Bengbeh leh ṭhite awrhin a inchei mawi a,
A ngaihzâwngte a chhai ṭhîn.
Baal hnênah inthawina a hlân fo,
Kei mi theihnghilh avângin ka hrem a ni,”
Lalpa thuchhuak chuan a ti.

en: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
mz: mi fing chuan a kalna a hria a, mi â chuan a hre lo va, mahse khawrel thuhmun an zaa chungah a thleng tho tih ka hmu.

en: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
