Basan ram berâm leh kêlchal ang,
Buh tui ber leh uain ṭha ber an nei.

en: And this I say for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is seemly, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
mz: Hei hi in tâna sâwt tûr a nih avângin ka sawi a ni; khuahkhirh ka tum che u a ni lo ve, mawi taka in awm theih nân leh Lalpa rawngbâwl tûra in inpumpêk theihna tûrin ka sawi zâwk a ni.

en: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie unto you in my name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
mz: Israel-te Pathian, Engkim Lalpa chuan Kolaia fapa Ahaba leh Maaseia fapa Zedekia, ka hminga dâwt thu puang ṭhînte chungchâng heti hian a sawi: ‘Ngai teh, anni chu Babulon lal Nebukadnezara ka mantîr ang a, in hmuh lai ngeiin a that ang.

en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?
mz:
Engkimtitheia chungah a lâwm ang em?
Pathian chu eng lai pawhin a ko vang em?

en: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
mz: Tin, LALPA chuan a hnênah, “Mihring kâ hi tu siam nge ni a, mitvâr te, mitdel te pawh hi tu tih nge ni? Kei LALPA hian a ni lo vem ni?

en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the dark; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the land: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
mz: An hmuh ngeiah pu la, thimah chhuahpui rawh, kawng i hmuh theih loh nân i mit khuh ang che; Israel-te tân chhinchhiahnaah ka siam dâwn che a ni,” a ti a.

en: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differeth from another star in glory.
mz: Ni hian ama ropuina a nei a, thlain ropuina hran a nei a, arsi pawhin ropuina hrang a nei, arsi hrang hrang ropui dân pawh a inang lo.

en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
mz: LALPAN Ahaba chhûngte chungchâng thu a sawi, LALPA thu chu leilungah hian a luang râl hlek lo vang tih hre rawh u; LALPAN a chhiahhlawh Elija hmanga a sawi kha a rawn hlen ta ai hi,” a ti a.

en: and Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
mz: Moza fapa chu Binea a ni. Binea hian fapa Refaia a nei a, chu mi chuan fapa, Azela pa Eleasa a nei a.

en: Indeed, our association with the congregation helps us to become wise . —Prov. 13:20; read 1 Peter 4:10.
mz: Dik takin, kohhrana mite nêna inkawmna chuan fing tûrin min ṭanpui a ni.—Thuf. 13:20; 1 Petera 4:10 chhiar rawh.

en: The apostle Paul told Christian overseers: “From among you yourselves men will rise and speak twisted things to draw away the disciples after themselves.” —Acts 20:29, 30.
mz: Tirhkoh Paula chuan Kristian enkawltute chu: “In zînga mi ngei pawh hi, zirtîrhote in hnêna pakaitîr tûrin thu hran sawi in lo la awm ang,” tiin a hrilh a ni.—Tirhkohte 20:29, 30.

en: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.
mz: Ani chuan, ‘Thu dik ka hrilh a che u, hêng mi tê berte zînga pakhat chunga in ti lo chu ka chunga ti lo in ni,’ tiin a la chhâng ang.

en: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
mz: Tin, ani chuan, “Tha lam thu-ah ni e: LALPA hnêna inthawi tûra lo kal ka ni; intithianghlim ula inthawinaah lo kal ve rawh u,” a ti a. Tin, Jesaia leh a fapate chu a tithianghlim a, inthawinaah chuan a ko va.

en: “Keep asking in faith, not doubting at all .” —JAMES 1:6.
mz: “Ringhlel hauh lovin rinna neiin dîl rawh se.”—JAKOBA 1:6.

en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, [namely], of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
mz: Hei hi Nova thlah chhâwng zêlte chanchin a ni. Nova fa Sema te, Hama te, Jafeta te chuan tuilêt hnuah fa an nei hlawm a.

en: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
mz: Tin, Naamana chu a va lût a, “Israel rama hmeiche naupang te khan chutiang khatiang chuan a ti e,” tiin a pu chu a hrilh a.

en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
mz: Anni chu an hun hmaa lak bovin an awm a, An innghahna chu lui len bovin a awm a;

en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
mz: Ka kawngte chu a hmuin Ka ke pen zawng zawng a chhiar lo vem ni?

en: I made me gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit;
mz: Huan nuam tak tak ka nei a, thei tinrêng ka phun bawk a.

en: and were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
mz: an vaiin chhûmah leh tuifinriatah Mosia zui tûra baptis an nih kha.

en: (Proverbs 8:30; John 1:3) Jehovah and his Son worked together to bring all other things into being .
mz: (Thufingte 8:30; Johana 1:3) Jehova leh a Fapa chuan thil dang zawng zawng chu an siam dûn a ni.

en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
mz: Hmêlma kut ata mi chhan chhuak teh u’ emaw Hnehchhiahtute kut ata mi tlan teh u’ emaw ka ti êm ni?

en: He trusted that with Jehovah’s help, he would be able to foil this evil plot and push forward with the building project . —Nehemiah 6:5-9.
mz: Jehova ṭanpuinain he thiltum sual hi tibahlahin, kulh sakna hna chu a chhunzawm thei dâwn tih a ring tlat a ni. —Nehemia 6: 5-9.

en: also from Beth-gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
mz: Beth-gilgal aṭang te, Geba aṭang te, Asmavet khua aṭang te pawhin an lo kal a.

en: So Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of Jehovah had made in the wilderness.
mz: Gibeon khuaa kal vek tûrin a hrilh a; chutah chuan Lalpa nêna Inbiakna Bûk, Lalpa chhiahhlawh Mosian thlalêra a siam kha a la awm ta reng a ni.

en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
mz: Nimahsela, anmahni avângin kan Pathian hnênah kan ?awng?ai a, chhûn leh zânah an laka vêngtu kan dah reng a.

en: And the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Jehovah.
mz: Tichuan, puithiam te, zâwlnei te, mipui zawng zawngte chuan hêng thu, Lalpa ina Jeremia sawi chu an hria a.

en: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
mz: Sumdawng rualte chuan an kawng an rawn pensan a, Ram rovah an lût a, an boral a.

en: And he taught them many things in parables, and said unto them in his teaching,
mz: Tehkhin thuin thu tam tak a zirtîr a, a zirtîr lai chuan an hnênah, “Ngai thla teh u.

en: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
mz: Chutichuan sawmthum chunga hotu Amasaia chungah chuan thlarau a lo thleng a, “David, i mite kan ni e, Jesaia fapa, i lama tang kan ni e, i chungah thlamuanna awm rawh se, nangmah puitute chungah apwh thlamuanna awm rawh se; i Pathian chuan a tanpui thin si chia,” a ti a. Tichan Davida chuan anmahni chu a la a, siapi pawl hotuahte a siam ta a.

en: Then, as the Bible says, “ commit to Jehovah whatever you do, and your plans will succeed.” —Proverbs 16:3; 20:18.
mz: Bible chuan: “I hnate chu LALPA kawltîr rawh, tichuan i thil ruahmante chu tihnghehin a awm ang,” tiin a sawi si a.—Thufingte 16:3; 20:18.

en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
mz: Israel chuan a Siamtu a theihnghilh a, In ropuite a sa a; Juda chuan khawpui kulhte a tipung a; Mahse, a khawpuiahte chuan mei ka tîr ang a, A in ropuite chu a kâng zo vang.”

en: Yea, can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, The thunderings of his pavilion?
mz:
Chhûm insemdarh dânte hi mihringin a hre thei em?
A awmna hmun ata khawpui a rîktîr dur dur dânte hi?

en: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.
mz: Setha a neih hnu chuan Adama chu kum zariat a dam a, fanu fapa dangte a nei a.

en: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul.
mz:
Eng nge ka sawi tâk ang?
Min hrilh angin i rawn ti ta ngei a,
Ka tuarna avâng hian ka dam chhûngin ka kal dêm dêm tawh ang.

en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
mz: Tin, a chawm nân chuan a dam chhûng ni zawng zawng, a thih ni thlengin, a ni tin, chanvo chu Babulon lalin a pe fo thin a.

en: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
mz: Chutichuan Hazaela chua amah be tûr chuan a va kal a, lawmman atân Damaska khuaa thil tha tinreng, sanghawngsei sawmli phur a keng a, a hmaah chuan a va ding a, “I fapa Benhadada, Suria lalin, ‘Ka nâ hi ka tha chhuak leh ang em?’ ti tûrin i hnênah hian mi rawn tir a ni,” a ti a.

en: give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, shall they give into your bosom. For with what measure ye mete it shall be measured to you again.
mz: Pe rawh u; tichuan, pêk in ni ang; ṭhahnemngai taka teh chhuaka, beng mukin, sâwi liam zawih zawih khawpin in ângchhûngah pêk in ni ang. Tehna in hman ngei khân tehsak in ni ang,” a ti a.

en: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
mz: Tin, chuta tang chuan Bethel-ah a han chho va; tin, chu mi kanwga a kal lai chuan khua ata mipa naupangho an lo chhuak a, an rawn nuihzat a, a hnênah, “Nang lukawlhpa, han cho tawh; nang lukawlhpa, han cho tawh,” an ti a.

en: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
mz: Hriamhrei kenga Jordan an kânpui duh loh che u erawh chuan Kanan ramah, in zîngah, chanvo an nei ve mai tûr a ni,” a ti a.

en: (1 Kings 3:12; 11:1, 2) God’s Law stated that the king should not take “many wives for himself, so that his heart may not go astray .”
mz: (1 Lalte 3:12; 11:1, 2) Pathian Dân chuan lalin “a rilru a vahbo loh nân nupui pawh a ngah tûr a ni lo,” tih a târ lang a.

en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
mz: Aw LALPA, kan Lalpa, Lei chung zawng zawngah hian i hming a va tha êm.

en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
mz: Tin, Hiv mi Hamora, chu mi ram lal fapa Sekema chuan ani chu a lo hmu a; tin, a man a, a mutpui a, a tlâwm ta a.

en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles. And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
mz: Chuvang chuan ngai rawh u, “Ni chu a lo thleng e, a bun chhuaktu tûr chu ka rawn tir ang a, tin, annin an bun chhuak ang,” tih hi LALPA thu chhuak a ni: a belte chu a tiruak ang a, a burte chu a tisawm ang a, Israel chhûngten an rinpui ber Bethel an zahpui8 angin Moab chuan Khemos a zahpui tawh ang.

en: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
mz: Jonathana chuan, “Chutiang chu ring rêng rêng suh, ka pain i chungah thil ṭha lo tih a tum ka hriat phawt chuan ka hrilh loh che i ring em ni?” a ti a.

en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
mz: Dan ngaithla duh lova hnuchhawntu chu A tawngtaina pawh tenawm a ni.

en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
mz: Ka thlarau chu chhûngah a chauh lai kha, nangmah ngeiin ka kawng chu i hria a. Ka kalna kawngah hian ka awh nân thang an kam ru a.

en: Then said the king to Amasa, Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be thou here present.
mz: Lal chuan Amasa hnênah, “Ni thum chhûngin Juda mite hi ko khâwm la; tah chuan, nang pawh lo awm ve ang che,” a ti a.

en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
mz: Chunga Pathian laka chanvo leh Chungnung ber Engkimtitheia laka rochan tûr chu eng nge ni?

en: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel; and he said, Because this nation have transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
mz: Israel-ho chungah Lalpa thinrim chu a alh ṭhîn a, “An pate zâwm tûra ka tih ka thuthlung chu he chite hian an bawhchhia a, ka aw lah an ngaithla duh hek lo; Josua a thiha, hnam dang a hnawh chhuah lohte kha

en: When thou art come unto the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are round about me;
mz: “Lalpa in Pathianin ram a pêk tûr che u in thlena, in neiha, awmhmun in benbel hnu chuan, ‘Kan vêla hnamte angin lal i nei ve ang,’ in la ti ang.

en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
mz: Tlangvâl chuan a chhun hlum ta a. Israel mite chuan Abimeleka a thi ta tih an hriat chuan mahni in lamah an haw ta ṭheuh va.

en: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
mz: Ai khaw lal erawh chu a nungin an man a, Josua hnênah an rawn hruai a.

en: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: As mine anger and my wrath hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so shall my wrath be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt; and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
mz: “Engkim Lalpa, Israel-te Pathian chuan heti hian a ti: ‘Ka thinurna nasa tak Jerusalem-a ka leihbua ang khân Aigupta-a kalte chungah pawh ka leihbua ang. nchhia te, hmusit te, sawichhiat te leh hau te in tuar ang a, he ram hi in hmu leh tawh lo vang.’

en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
mz: chu zawlnei emaw, mang neitu emaw thute chu in pawm tur ani lo; LALPA in Pathian chuan in thinlung zawng zawng leh in nunna zawng zawngin LALPA in Pathian chu in hmangaih nge hmangaih lo tih hriat nan a fiah che u ani e.

en: And David perceived that Jehovah had established him king over Israel; for his kingdom was exalted on high, for his people Israel's sake.
mz: Lalpa chuan Israel-te chunga a lalna chu a tinghetin a mi Israel-te avângin a ram pawh a chawimawi ta hle tih Davida chuan a hria a.

en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.
mz: Hri a reh hnu chuan Arona chu Inbiakna bûkah Mosia hnênah chuan a kal leh ta a.

en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost its savor, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
mz: “Lei chi in ni e; nimahsela, chi hi da ta ang se, engtia tihal leh tûr nge ni ang? Paih chhuaha, mite rah mai mai chauhvah lo chuan eng atân mah a tlâktlai tawh lo vang.

en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
mz:
Jerusalem-ah kum thum a lal a, a nu chu Gibea khaw mi Uriela fanu Mikaii a ni.
Abija leh Jeroboama chu an indo ta a.

en: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is the Christ, or, Here; believe [it] not.
mz: “Chutih hunah chuan tu pawhin in hnênah, ‘En teh u, Krista chu heta hi,’ emaw, ‘Sawta saw,’ emaw an tih pawhin awih duh suh ang che u.

en: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, that thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out now, I pray, and fight with them.
mz: Zebula chuan heti hian a ti ta a, “Abimeleka hi tu nge maw a nih a a rawng kan bâwlna tûr!’ i tihna hmui kha khawiah nge a awm tâk? I hmuhsit êm êmte kha an nih saw. Chhuak la, va bei ta che,” a ti a.

en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
mz: Lal Belsazzara rorêl kum thumnaah chuan ka hnênah, kei Daniela hnên ngeiah hian inlârna a lo lang a, a tîra ka hnêna lo lang hnuah khân.

en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
mz: Ka thu chu ahmaah ka thlena ng a, Ka ka tanfungin a khat ang.

en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
mz: Chumi tum chuan Jordan rala awm Amor ho lal pahnih kut ata chu Arnon ruam atanga Hermon tlâng thlenga ram chu kan la a;

en: saying, What think ye of the Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, [The son] of David.
mz: “Krista chu eng angin nge in ngaih? Tu fapa nge ni?” a ti a. Anni chuan, “Davida,” an ti a.

en: And it was so, that, when they that bare the ark of Jehovah had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.
mz: Lalpa Bâwm zâwntuten bâwm chu pên ruk an han kalpui a, Davida chuan a dintîr rih a, bâwngpa leh ran chawm thau inthawina a hlân a.

en: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
mz: Tin, karea fapa Johanana leh a hnêna sipai pâwl hotu zawng zawng chuan, Nethania fapa Ismaela laka Johanan a chan chhuah tawh mi la awm chhun zawng zawng, indo mite, hmeichhia te, naupang te, mi tilreh te, Gibeon atanga a hruai lehte chu an hruai ta vek a.

en: (Psalm 119:9, 17, 41, 42) As you look forward to a study of the rest of this beautiful psalm, you might well ask yourself, ‘Do I really let Jehovah’s word light my roadway?’
mz: (Sâm 119: 9, 17, 41, 42) He fakna hla mawi tak a la bâk zawngte zir hun tûr nghah pahin, heti hian kan inzâwt tûr a ni, ‘Jehova thu chu ka kawng ka tihêntîr tak zet em?’ tiin.(w05 4/15)

en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
mz: Esauva chuan a nupui te, a fanu leh fapa te, an chhûng zînga awm ve zawng zawng te, a ran vulh, ran chi hrang hrang te, Kanan rama sum leh pai a neih tâk te chu chhawmin, a nau Jakoba dîp lo tûrin, Seir tlângramah a pêm ta a.

en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.
mz: Tin, mihring chu 16,000 an ni a; chu mia LALPA chhiah chu mi 32 an ni.

en: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
mz: Bathsebi chu Adonija biaksak tûrin lal Solomona hnênah a kal a; lal chu amah lo lâwm tûrin a tho va, kûnin chibai a bûk a, lalṭhutthlêngah chuan a ṭhu leh ta a. Lal nu tân ṭhutthlêng dang an rawn la a, a ding lamah chuan an ṭhuttîr a.

en: but had certain questions against him of their own religion, and of one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.
mz: Anmahni sakhaw thu leh mi pakhat thi tawh, Paulan a nung leha a sawi, Isua chungthu-ah an buai a lo ni lek a.

en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
mz: Paula, Silvana leh Timothea chuan, Thesalonika khuaa Pa Pathian leh Lalpa Isua Krista kohhran chibai kan bûk e. Khawngaihna leh remna in hnênah awm rawh se.

en: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
mz: Asera thlahte chu a chi leh a chhûngkuaa thliarin mipa râlkai chin, kum sawmhnih chung lam chu a upat dân indawtin an hming an ziak a.

en: I said, I would scatter them afar, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men;
mz:
Tu ma hriat tawh loh tûrin
Tihmang dêr ka tum hial a.

en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
mz: Bawhchhiatna thuptu chuan inhmangaihna a zawng a, Thil sawi sawi hmang chuan thian bulte a tithen thin.

en: Thus saith Jehovah to me: Make thee bonds and bars, and put them upon thy neck;
mz: Lalpa chuan ka hnênah heti hian a ti: “Nghâwngkawl tuk la, a hrui vuahin i nghâwngah bât rawh.

en: And upon the first day of the week, when we were gathered together to break bread, Paul discoursed with them, intending to depart on the morrow; and prolonged his speech until midnight.
mz: Pathiannia chhang phel tûra kan inkhâwmin, Paula chuan a tûka kal a tum avângin an hnênah thu a sawi a, zanlai thlengin a sawi a.

en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
mz: Tin, Pharaoa chuan chu mi tum pawh chuan a thinlung a tikhauh leh a, tichuan mite chu a chhuahtîr phal ta lo va.

en: (1 Kings 19:4) And the apostle Paul must have felt the full burden of his imperfection when he admitted : “When I wish to do what is right, what is bad is present with me.”
mz: (1 Lalte 19:4) Tin, tirhkoh Paula chuan: “Thil ṭha tih ka duh laiin sualna ka hnênah a lo awm ṭhîn a ni,” tia a inpuan khân, a ṭhat famkim lohna chu a manganpui hle ngei ang.

en: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
mz: Ngai rawh, Lebanon zâr mawi leh Buk, hlim chhah, sâng mawi, A zîk chhûm kâra lêng i iang e.

en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
mz: Tin, Arona chuan rawnga bâwlna turin chutiang chuan ain thuam tur a ni: tichuan hmunthianghlima LALPA hmaa a lo luh leh a chhuah hunah a ri chu hriat theih a ni tur a ni, chutilo chuan thi mai ang.

en: Remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Miriam, by the way as ye came forth out of Egypt.
mz: Aigupta ram aṭanga in lo chhuah kawngah Miriami chunga Lalpa in Pathian thiltih kha hre reng rawh u.

en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
mz: Tin, tupawh a khum khawih apiangte chuan an puante an su ang a, an inbual tur a ni a, tlai lam thlengin an bawlhhlaw ang.

en: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
mz: Tin, ka hnênah, “Mihring fapa, i hmuh kha ei rawh; lehkhabu zial hi ei la, Israela chhûngte hnênah chuan thu va sawi rawh,” a ti a.

en: Now these are the chiefs of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, [to wit], Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants.
mz: Israel rama khawpui deuhvah leh khaw tê deuhva awm puithiam te, Levia chi te, Tempul enkawltute leh Solomona chhiahhlawh thlahte chu an awmna khuaah mahni in ngeiah an awm a ni. Judai rama mi, mi lâr deuh deuh Jerusalem khuaa awmte chu hêng hi an ni:

en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
mz: Meikhu ur savun peng ang chu ka lo ni ta si a; Nimahsela i thuruatte chu ka theihnghilh lo ve.

en: And when he had agreed with the laborers for a shilling a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
mz: Hnathawktute nên ni khata duli hlawha an inrem veleh a grep huanah a tîr ta a.

en: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
mz: “Khatah riak tawh suh u, a sâwt lo, khatianga in tih leh chuan in chungah kut ka rawn thlâk tawh ang,” ka ti a. Chuta chin chu sabat niin an lo kal leh tawh ngai lo.

en: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they are come up upon my neck; He hath made my strength to fail: The Lord hath delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
mz:
Ka sual a ṭâwn khâwm a, amah ngeiin min awrhtîr a,
A nghâwngkawl chu min bahtîr a, a rit êm a, ka chau zo ta.
Lalpan hmêlma kutah min hlân ta a ni,
Ka tluk lohte kutah chuan.

en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD's passover.
mz: Thla khatna, ni sâwm leh ni lo ni tlai lam chu LALPA Kalhlen Kût a ni.

en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
mz: sakhi te, sangai te, sakhipa te, sathar te, ram kel te, ram lawi te, ram beram te hi.

en: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
mz: In zinga hnam te ber pawh hnam ropui tak an ni ang a, hnam tlemte pawh hnam chak tak an ni ang: kei LALPA hian a hun hunah chuan ka thlentir thuai ang.

en: (Genesis 4:3-7) Truly, Jehovah is the embodiment of mildness. —Exodus 34:6.
mz: (Genesis 4: 3-7) Dik takin, Jehova chuan thuhnuairawlhna lama entawn tûr ṭha famkim a siam a ni. —Exodus 34:6.

en: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.
mz:
I phaw kengin i âwmphaw pawh ha la,
Min pui tûrin lo thawk ang che.

en: And your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
mz:
Thihna nêna in thuthlung chu sût a ni ang a,
Mitthi khua nêna in thutiam pawh chu ṭhiat a ni ang.
Hremna lui lo lian chuan,
Nangni pawh a chîm pil ngei ang che u.

en: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.
mz: Tin, anni chuan, LALPA chu i hnênah a awm tih chiang takin kan hria a, tichuan, ‘I pawi kan khawih ngai loh ang leh thil tha chauh lo chu i chungah engmah reng reng kan tih loh va tlang taka kan kal botîr ta che ang khan, keini pawh kan chhiatna tur reng reng i tih lohna turin kan karah, keini leh nangma kar ngeiah hian chhechhamna lo awm tawh sela, i hnênah thu min thluntîr rawh,’ kan ti: tunah chuan nang zawnh LALPA malsawm dawngtu i nih tawh hi,” an ti a.

en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
mz: Juda lal Josia fapa, Jehoiakima lal kum linaah Lalpa thu Jeremia hnênah a lo thleng a.

en: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that, when any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.
mz: Absaloma chu zîng takah a tho va, kulh kawngka bulah chuan a lo ding ṭhîn a, lal hnêna thubuai sawi tûr neite chu Absaloma chuan a lo ko va, “Khawii khua nge i nih le?” a lo ti ṭhîn a. Anni chuan, “I chhiahhlawh hi Israel hnam zînga mi ka ni,” an ti zêl a.

en: However, as time went on and the Christian congregation was about to be established , the role of an apostle became an “office of oversight.” —Acts 1:20-26.
mz: Mahse, hun a liam zêl a, Kristian kohhran din a nih dâwn hnaihah chuan, tirhkohte chuan “hotu” nihna chanvo an lo chelh chho ta a ni.—Tirh. 1:20-26.

en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
mz: Anni chu thir tiangin i tikeh ang a; Belvawtu bel an paih keh sawm ang hian i paih keh sawm ang,” a ti a.

en: (Deuteronomy 14:1) Witness youths have been the target of relentless name- calling because of adhering to Jehovah’s moral standards.
mz: (Deuteronomy 14:1) Thuhretu ṭhalaite chu Jehova nungchâng tehna an vawn avângin sawichhiat reng an ni a.

en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
mz: Kha mi lai ngei khan tuite chuan min chim pil tawh ang a, Lui chuan kan nuna hi a vur pil tawh ang: Kha mi lai ngei khan tui chapote chuan kan nuna hi a vur pil tawh ang.

en: The Lord is become as an enemy, he hath swallowed up Israel; He hath swallowed up all her palaces, he hath destroyed his strongholds; And he hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
mz:
Lalpa chu hmêlma ang mai a ni,
Israel-te a lem zo va,
An kulhte leh an in ropuite a tichhia a,
Judai ram chhûngah lusûn rûnpui a thlentîr ta.

en: And the court which is without the temple leave without, and measure it not; for it hath been given unto the nations: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
mz: Tempul hung chhûng kawtlai erawh chu kân la, teh tel suh; Jentail-te hnêna pêk a ni tawh si a, Jentail-ten khawpui thianghlim chu thla sawmli leh pahnih chhûng an rapbet ang.

en: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.
mz: Tin, hmun thuma thena hmun khat chu lal inah in awm ang a; tin, hmun thuma thena hmun khat chu kulh kawngkaah; tin, mipui zawng zawng chu LALPA in kawt hung chhûngah an awm ang.

en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth [day] of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers' houses, a lamb for a household: [
mz: Israel pungkhâwmho hrilh rawh: Tûn thla ni sâwm ni hian chhûng tin mahni chhûng ei tâwk berâmno emaw, kêltê emaw thlang ṭheuh rawh se.

en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
mz:
Ka tha lah chu hlumbêl keh them angin a ro zo va,
Ka dangah hian ka lei a bet:
Thi ang dêrin vaivutah chuan min mut a.

en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
mz: Abib thla, vawiin nî hian in chhuak a ni.

en: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
mz: LALPA chuan a hmangaihte chu a zilhhau thin a ni, Pain fa a lawm apiangte a zilhhau thin ang hian.

en: [For the Chief Musician; A Psalm of David, a Song]. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.
mz:
Pathian lo thawk sela,
hmêlmate darh rawh se,
A hmaah chuan amah hawtute chu tlânchhe rawh se.

en: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
mz: chung chu in fate in ziritir ang a, in ina in thut lai te, kawnga in kal lai te, in mut lai te, in thawh hun tein in sawi thin tur a ni.

en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
mz: Tin, Sekema chuan nula pa leh a nutate hnênah, “Mi khawngaih rawh u, ka hnêna in sawi apiang ka pe zêl ang che u.

en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
mz: Gezera te, Hoda te, Sama te, Silsa te, Itharana te, Beera te an ni.

en: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
mz: chungte chu tiam lovin Solomona chuan a hna chunga hotu bik, hnathawk vengtu sângthum leh zathum anei bawk a.

en: And they trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
mz: Mite chuan an pate Pathian chu an hawisan a; chûng rama lo awm, Pathianin a hnawh chhuahte pathian chu an be ta a.

en: Whether then [it be] I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
mz: Tichuan, kei pawhin, anni pawhin khati khân kan hril ṭhîn a, nangni pawhin chu ngei chu in ring ta a.

en: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.
mz: Nail lui chu ka tikang ang a, mi sual pui pui kutah ka pe ang. Hnam dang mite chuan ram chu, a chhûnga awmte nên an tichhe vek ang. Kei Lalpa hian ka sawi tawh hi.”

en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air, The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
mz: Chuvangin fimkhur hle rawh u; milem te insiam chawpin, a pa ang emaw, a nu ang emaw, leia ran ang emaw, boruaka thlawk thin, sava thla nei ang emaw, leia a vaha vak mi ang emaw, lei hnuai tuia sangha zinga mi ang emaw te siamin in intichhe dah rual ang e; Horeb tlânga mei atanga Lalpan a rawn biak ni che u khan riruang engmah in hmu si lo va; a nih loh leh van lam in han hawi a, ni te, thla te, arsite vana mi zawng zawngte reng pawh in han hmuhin, LALPA in Pathianin van hnuai chhina mi zawng zawng a ruasakte chuan a hip ang che u a, in bia ang a, an rawngte in bawl mai dah rual ang e.

en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
mz: Chu mi hmun hmingah chuan Massa leh Meriba a vuah a, Israela thlahten an bei avâng leh, “Kan zîngah hian LALPA chu a awm nge maw awm lo le?” tia LALPA chu an fiah avângin.

en: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
mz: Tin, Estheri chuan, “Taitu leh hmêlma a ni, he mi sualpa Hamana hi a ni,” a ti a. Chutichuan lalnu leh LALPA hmaah Hamana chu a khur ta a.

en: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
mz: A chhûngkua diat diatin Gada thlahte chu: Zefona, Zefon hnam thlahtu; Hagia, Hagi hnam thlahtu; Sunia, Suni hnam thlahtu;

en: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
mz: hmâr lam aram leh a um darhna ram zawng zawng ata Israel chhûngte thlahho hruai chhuak a, hruai kir lehtu LALPA chu a nuna a nun chhûng chu’ an ti tawh zawk ang. Tin, anmahni ram ngeiah an cheng ang.

en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
mz: Kum ṭhat kum sarih chhûng chuan buh tawntawin a haw a.

en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
mz: Lal thinrim chu sakeibaknei rum ang a ni a, A duhsakna erawh chu hlobet chunga dai ang a ni.

en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
mz: chu mi leh ahmanrua zawng zawng chu a khuna savun tha mia khuhin a zawnnaah an dah tur a ni.

en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;
mz:
Khumah ka mu hahdam ang a, muhîl ila,
Ka na a nuam deuh mahna ka tih leh

en: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; [But] he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
mz:
Ṭawng fîmkhur hi mahni invênna a ni a,
Mi ṭawng tlahawlh chuan ama chhiatna a thlen ṭhîn.

en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.
mz: Chawlh tûr ka tih nite serh ula, chibai mi bûkna hmun chu zah rawh u, Lalpa ka nih hi.

en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
mz: Tin, tlânga Pathian mi hnên a han thlen chuan, a ke a han vuan ta tlat a. Tin, amah chu rawn nam kian tumin Gehazia chuan a va pan a; nimahsela Pathian mi chuan, “Engmah tih suh, a rilru a mangang a nih hi; LALPAN ka lakah ala thup rih a, mi la hrilh rih lo ve,” a ti a.

en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, [saying] ,
mz: Davida chuan Solomona pui tûrin Israel hruaitute chu a hrilh a,

en: (Luke 23:50-52; John 7:45-52; 19:38-40) The relief that humans achieve when they stand up in defense of Jehovah’s people —for whatever reason— is limited at best.
mz: (Luka 23: 50- 52; Johana 7: 45- 52; 19: 38- 40) Jehova mite chhan tûra mihringte ṭanpuina chu —eng ang rilru put vânga ṭanpui duh pawh ni mah se —a beitham hle ṭhîn.

en: According to the parallel account in Mark, the Pharisee then said to Jesus: “Teacher, you well said in line with truth, ‘He is One, and there is no other than He’; and this loving him with one’s whole heart and with one’s whole understanding and with one’s whole strength and this loving one’s neighbor as oneself is worth far more than all the whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.” —Mark 12:32, 33.
mz: Chanchin thu hmun ziakna Marka ziakah, Pharisai chuan Isua hnênah: “A ni tak e, zirtirtu, amah chu pakhat chauh a ni a, amah lo chu tumah dang an awm lo va, amah chu thinlung zawng zawnga, hriatna zawng zawnga, chakna zawng zawnga hmangaih a, mahni inhmangaih angin vêngte hmangaih hi pumhâl thilpêk leh inthawina zawng zawng aiin a ṭha zâwk êm êm tih hi i sawi dik zet mai,” a ti a ni. —Marka 12: 32, 33.

en: (Acts 24:15) These ones will have the prospect of living in a world in which “ righteousness is to dwell.” —2 Peter 3:13.
mz: (Tirhkohte 24:15) Chûng mite chuan khawvêl, ‘a chhûnga felna awma’ nun beiseina chu an nei a ni. —2 Petera 3:13.

en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
mz: Amah chauh chu ka lungpi leh ka chhandamna a ni: Ka kulhbing sâng ani a; ka nghing lo vang.
